title: How Private is Private? A Comparative Study for Face De-Identification
title_zh: 隐私究竟有多“私”？一项关于面部去身份识别的对比研究

paragraphs.en: Face de-identification (FDeID) has emerged as a critical privacy-preserving technology, yet its evaluation remains fundamentally fragmented. Existing protocols rely on inconsistent metrics, heterogeneous datasets, and partial annotation coverage, so methods targeting different utility dimensions, such as landmark versus expression preservation, are reported on different benchmarks under different metrics, rendering cross-method comparison infeasible. We revisit FDeID evaluation from both the data and metric perspectives. On the data side, we introduce UtilFace , a curated, demographically balanced benchmark with high identity diversity, assembled from four large-scale face datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering. On the metric side, we propose HiFD , a Hi erarchical F ace D e-identification metric that unifies identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality under a single consistency-based paradigm: every component is computed from pretrained estimators’ outputs on the original face and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying how much identity is suppressed and how much downstream-perceivable utility survives. HiFD organizes facial signals into a three-level utility hierarchy spanning macro cues (L1), micro cues (L2), and imperceptible cues (L3), and aggregates the five resulting components into a single interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean, with configurable application-specific profiles. Using this unified protocol, we conduct a comprehensive comparative study spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods, surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under existing protocols. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit to foster systematic and reproducible research in privacy-preserving human face analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 面部去身份识别（FDeID）已成为一项关键的隐私保护技术，但其评估方式仍然高度碎片化。 现有协议依赖不一致的指标、异构的数据集以及不完整的标注覆盖，因此针对不同效用维度（例如地标特征保留与表情保留）的方法，往往在不同基准数据集上、使用不同指标进行报告，导致跨方法比较无法实现。 我们从数据和指标两个角度重新审视 FDeID 的评估问题。 在数据层面，我们提出了 UtilFace——一个经过精心构建且人口统计学特征均衡的基准数据集，具有高度身份多样性。该数据集通过身份感知的清洗、分辨率增强和分层过滤，从四个大规模面部数据集整合而成。 在指标层面，我们提出了 HiFD（分层面部去身份识别指标），它将身份抑制、多级效用保留和图像质量统一到一个基于一致性的单一框架中：每个组件均基于预训练估计器对原始面部及其去身份识别后的对应图像的输出计算得出，直接量化了身份信息的抑制程度以及下游可感知效用的保留程度。 HiFD 将面部信号组织为包含三个层级的效用层次结构，涵盖宏观特征（L1）、微观特征（L2）和不可感知特征（L3），并通过加权调和平均将五个最终组件整合为一个可解释的单一分数，同时支持针对具体应用的配置化配置文件。 基于这一统一协议，我们开展了一项全面的比较研究，涵盖了对抗性方法、GAN 基方法和扩散模型基方法，揭示了在现有协议中难以察觉的权衡关系与失效模式。 我们公开了该基准数据集和评估工具包，以推动隐私保护型人类面部分析领域系统化且可复现的研究。

paragraphs.en: The ubiquity of visual sensing in modern society has intensified the tension between advancing computer vision capabilities and privacy protection Hukkelås et al. (2019) ; Hasan et al. (2023) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Jia et al. (2025) ; Laishram et al. (2025) . Among all visual cues, human faces constitute uniquely identifying biometric signals and are captured pervasively by surveillance cameras, autonomous vehicles, and smart devices, often without explicit user consent Schroff et al. (2015) ; Deng et al. (2020) . This reality has motivated extensive research on face de-identification (FDeID), which aims to modify facial imagery such that identity recognition is prevented while other task-relevant visual information is preserved for downstream applications Maximov et al. (2020) ; Lopez et al. (2024) ; Hinojosa et al. (2022) ; Zhou et al. (2025) . Despite over two decades of active research, a fundamental question remains insufficiently answered: how private is private?
paragraphs.zh: 视觉感知在现代社会中的普遍存在，加剧了计算机视觉能力进步与隐私保护之间的紧张关系 Hukkelås et al. (2019) ; Hasan et al. (2023) ; Gu et al. (2024) ; Jia et al. (2025) ; Laishram et al. (2025) . 在所有视觉特征中，人脸是独特的生物识别信号，且被监控摄像头、自动驾驶汽车和智能设备广泛捕捉，通常未经用户明确同意 Schroff et al. (2015) ; Deng et al. (2020) . 这一现实推动了关于人脸去标识化（FDeID）的广泛研究，其目标是对人脸图像进行修改，以防止身份识别，同时保留其他与任务相关的视觉信息以供下游应用使用 Maximov et al. (2020) ; Lopez et al. (2024) ; Hinojosa et al. (2022) ; Zhou et al. (2025) . 尽管经过二十多年的积极研究，一个基本问题仍未得到充分解答：隐私究竟有多私密？

paragraphs.en: Answering this question is hard because FDeID is inherently multi-objective. A successful method must not only suppress identity but also preserve various categories of facial utility, e.g. , age Geng et al. (2007) , gender Meng and Sun (2014) , expression Pan et al. (2024) , and landmarks Yang et al. (2024) , with the relevant subset depending on the downstream application. The community has responded by developing methods that each target a different subset of these utilities, and by evaluating each method on whichever dataset happens to carry the corresponding annotations. The result is a fragmented evaluation landscape in which a method optimized for expression preservation Yang et al. (2024) cannot be directly compared with one designed for detection preservation Jiang et al. (2023) , since they target fundamentally different utility dimensions on entirely different benchmarks Liu et al. (2025a) ; Wen et al. (2023) . This fragmentation is reinforced by the absence of a unified benchmark: no existing dataset jointly provides the annotation coverage, identity diversity, and image quality required for reliable multi-dimensional evaluation Huang et al. (2008) ; Liu et al. (2015) ; Moschoglou et al. (2017) ; Karras et al. (2019) , so prior works have relied on heterogeneous task-specific datasets that produce mutually incompatible results. For instance, A 3 GAN Zhai et al. (2022) evaluates expression preservation on ExpW Zhang et al. (2018b) , whereas SASMask Gong et al. (2023) assesses age preservation on AgeDB Moschoglou et al. (2017) , and the two simply cannot be meaningfully compared. We reviewed over 100 FDeID-related papers and quantified this fragmentation: more than 60 datasets and 20 evaluation metrics are used across prior protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 回答这个问题很困难，因为 FDeID 本质上具有多目标性。 一种成功的方法不仅要抑制身份识别，还要保留各类面部效用，例如年龄 Geng et al. (2007)、性别 Meng and Sun (2014)、表情 Pan et al. (2024) 以及面部地标 Yang et al. (2024)，其中相关的子集取决于下游应用。 研究界对此的回应是开发分别针对这些效用不同子集的方法，并在恰好包含相应标注的数据集上对每种方法进行评估。 其结果是一个碎片化的评估格局，其中一种针对表情保留进行优化的方法 Yang et al. (2024) 无法与专为检测保留而设计的方法 Jiang et al. (2023) 直接比较，因为它们针对的是完全不同的效用维度，且基于截然不同的基准 Liu et al. (2025a)；Wen et al. (2023)。 这种碎片化因缺乏统一基准而进一步加剧：目前没有任何数据集能同时提供可靠的多维度评估所需的标注覆盖、身份多样性和图像质量 Huang et al. (2008)；Liu et al. (2015)；Moschoglou et al. (2017) 上评估年龄保留，两者根本无法进行有意义的比较。 我们回顾了 100 多篇与 FDeID 相关的论文，并量化了这种碎片化：先前的协议中使用了超过 60 个数据集和 20 项评估指标。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the fragmentation of what is measured, we identify a deeper concern in how utility is measured. Existing protocols cast utility preservation as the classification or regression accuracy of attribute predictions against externally annotated labels: a method is said to preserve expression if a classifier still predicts the annotated expression label on the de-identified image Yang et al. (2021) ; Salar et al. (2025) . This formulation is problematic on two counts. Operationally , it requires per-attribute ground-truth annotations on the evaluation dataset, which is precisely why no single benchmark suffices for multi-attribute evaluation (Tab. 1 ) and why the field has fragmented across task-specific datasets in the first place. Conceptually , it misaligns evaluation with deployment: what matters in practice is whether downstream models can still extract task-relevant information from the de-identified face, not whether their predictions match a static set of human annotations. We argue instead that utility should be measured by the consistency s ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) , f ⁡ ( 𝐱 ^ ) ) s(f(\mathbf{x}),\,f(\hat{\mathbf{x}})) between an attribute estimator’s predictions on the original face 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and its de-identified counterpart 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} . This consistency-based formulation directly quantifies whether the information a model extracts from a face survives de-identification, eliminates the per-image annotation requirement, and unifies evaluation across attributes and datasets.

paragraphs.en: Orthogonal to how utility is measured, we further observe that facial signals exhibit a natural hierarchy of perceptual granularity that existing protocols overlook (Fig. 2 ). Macro-level cues such as demographics and facial geometry are spatially coarse, semantically salient, and readily perceivable by human observers Moschoglou et al. (2017) ; Mollahosseini et al. (2017) . Micro-level cues such as gaze direction and micro-expressions depend on precise localized geometry and temporal dynamics that are far more fragile under facial manipulation Krafka et al. (2016) ; Zhao et al. (2023) . Imperceptible cues such as rPPG-based physiological signals, encoded in sub-pixel skin color variations, are the most susceptible to any image modification Stricker et al. (2014) ; Joshi et al. (2024) . This stratification suggests that FDeID methods affect each level differently, which a single scalar utility score cannot expose, motivating a hierarchical metric that evaluates preservation at all three granularities and surfaces the trade-offs between them.

(2017)。 （2017）；Mollahosseini et al. (2017)。 微观层面的线索，如注视方向和微表情，依赖于精确的局部几何结构和时间动态特征，这些特征在面部处理操作下会变得更加脆弱 Krafka et al. (2016)；Zhao et al. (2023)。 不可察觉的线索，如基于rPPG的生理信号（编码于亚像素级的肤色变化中），最容易受到任何图像修改的影响 Stricker et al. (2014)；Joshi et al. (2024)。 这种分层结构表明，FDeID方法对各个层级的影响各不相同，而单一的标量效用分数无法揭示这一点。因此，有必要引入一种层级指标，用于评估在所有三种颗粒度下的信息保留情况，并揭示它们之间的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: Based on the above observations, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 基于上述观察，我们提出以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: UtilFace : a curated, balanced FDeID benchmark. We construct a face benchmark assembled from multiple large-scale datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering, providing a demographically balanced evaluation substrate with high identity diversity and image quality. We further integrate established video benchmarks (DFME Zhao et al. (2023) , PURE Stricker et al. (2014) ) to enable standardized evaluation across all utility levels.
paragraphs.zh: UtilFace：一个经过精心筛选和平衡的 FDeID 基准数据集。 我们通过身份识别相关的清理、分辨率增强和分层过滤，从多个大规模数据集中构建了一个面部基准数据集，从而提供了一个人口统计学特征均衡、身份多样性和图像质量均较高的评估基础。 我们还整合了成熟的视频基准数据集（DFME Zhao et al. (2023) 、PURE Stricker et al. (2014)），以实现所有效用水平下的标准化评估。

paragraphs.en: A three-level facial utility hierarchy. We propose the first structured formalization of facial utility for FDeID, organizing signals into macro-cues (L1), micro-cues (L2), and imperceptible-cues (L3), and providing a principled lens for understanding which downstream tasks remain viable after de-identification (see Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个三级面部效用层次结构。 我们为 FDeID 提出了面部效用的首个结构化形式化方法，将信号组织为宏观线索（L1）、微观线索（L2）和不可感知线索（L3），并为此提供了一个理论依据，用于理解在去标识化之后哪些下游任务仍然可行（见图 2）。

sents.en: A three-level facial utility hierarchy.
sents.zh: 一个三级面部效用层次结构。

sents.en: We propose the first structured formalization of facial utility for FDeID, organizing signals into macro-cues (L1), micro-cues (L2), and imperceptible-cues (L3), and providing a principled lens for understanding which downstream tasks remain viable after de-identification (see Fig. 2 ).
sents.zh: 我们为 FDeID 提出了面部效用的首个结构化形式化方法，将信号组织为宏观线索（L1）、微观线索（L2）和不可感知线索（L3），并为此提供了一个理论依据，用于理解在去标识化之后哪些下游任务仍然可行（见图 2）。

paragraphs.en: HiFD: a unified, consistency-based metric. We introduce HiFD ( Hi erarchical F ace D e-identification metric), which integrates identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality into an interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean aggregation, with application-specific weighting profiles and graceful adaptation across image and video modalities (see Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: HiFD：一种基于一致性的统一度量标准。 我们提出了 HiFD（Hi erarchical F ace D e-identification metric，即“分层面部去身份化度量标准”），它通过加权调和平均聚合，将身份抑制、多级效用保留和图像质量整合为一个可解释的分数，并支持针对特定应用的可配置权重配置文件，以及在不同图像和视频模态之间的平滑适应（参见图 1）。

paragraphs.en: A comprehensive comparative study of FDeID methods. We evaluate representative adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods under UtilFace and HiFD , surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under fragmented protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 对 FDeID 方法的全面比较研究。 我们在 UtilFace 和 HiFD 框架下评估了具有代表性的对抗性、基于 GAN 和基于扩散的方法，揭示了在碎片化协议下仍然不可见的权衡与失效模式。

sents.en: We evaluate representative adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods under UtilFace and HiFD , surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under fragmented protocols.
sents.zh: 我们在 UtilFace 和 HiFD 框架下评估了具有代表性的对抗性、基于 GAN 和基于扩散的方法，揭示了在碎片化协议下仍然不可见的权衡与失效模式。

paragraphs.en: FDeID has evolved substantially from early approaches to sophisticated learning-based techniques. Early methods employed simple image processing operations including pixelation, blurring, and masking Boyle et al. (2000) ; Hudson and Smith (1996) ; Letournel et al. (2015) ; Wei et al. (2026a) . While computationally efficient, these approaches fundamentally trade utility for privacy, degrading visual quality and destroying most facial information. The k k -Same family of algorithms Gross et al. (2005) ; Gross et al. (2006) ; Meng and Sun (2014) ; Newton et al. (2005) introduced a principled privacy formulation based on k k -anonymity Sweeney (2002) , synthesizing faces that match at least k k individuals in a database. However, these methods produce visible artifacts and offer limited control over the privacy-utility trade-off. Recent advances in generative modeling have enabled more nuanced approaches: Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) Goodfellow et al. (2014) -based methods disentangle identity from attributes Maximov et al. (2020) , inpaint faces conditioned on surrounding context Hukkelås and Lindseth (2023) , or manipulate latent representations Agarwal et al. (2021) , while diffusion models Ho et al. (2020) offer improved fidelity and controllability Sun et al. (2024) . Despite this methodological diversity, existing methods share a common evaluation blind spot: utility preservation is assessed in a fragmented manner, with each work measuring different attributes on different datasets using different metrics. Our benchmark addresses this gap through systematic, multi-level utility evaluation under a unified protocol.
paragraphs.zh: FDeID 已从早期的方法发展到了基于学习的复杂技术，实现了显著的进步。 早期方法采用了简单的图像处理操作，包括像素化、模糊化和掩膜处理 Boyle et al. (2000) ; Hudson and Smith (1996) ; Letournel et al. (2015) ; Wei et al. (2026a) . 尽管这些方法在计算上效率较高，但它们本质上以牺牲效用为代价来保护隐私，导致视觉质量下降并破坏了大部分面部信息。 k k -Same 算法系列 Gross et al. (2005) ; Gross et al. (2006) ; Meng and Sun (2014) ; Newton et al. (2005) 提出了一种基于 k k -匿名性 Sweeney (2002) 的规范化隐私构建方法，该方法合成了与数据库中至少 k k 个个体匹配的面部图像。 然而，这些方法会产生可见的人工伪影，并且对隐私与效用之间的权衡提供有限的控制能力。 生成式建模领域的最新进展催生了更精细的方法：基于生成对抗网络（GAN） Goodfellow et al. (2014) 的方法将身份与属性分离 Maximov et al. (2020) ，根据周围上下文条件修复面部图像 Hukkelås and Lindseth (2023) ，或操纵潜在表示 Agarwal et al. (2021) ，而扩散模型 Ho et al. (2020) 则提供了更高的保真度和更强的可控性 Sun et al. (2024) 。 尽管方法存在多样性，现有方法在评估上仍存在一个共同的盲点：效用保留的评估是碎片化的，每项研究都在不同的数据集上使用不同的指标测量不同的属性。 我们的基准测试通过统一协议下的系统性、多层次效用评估解决了这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of FDeID spans three dimensions: identity suppression, utility preservation, and image quality, each of which has accumulated a heterogeneous collection of metrics. Identity suppression is most commonly reported as the de-identification success rate Sharif et al. (2016) ; Khorzooghi and Nilizadeh (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2025b) ; Salar et al. (2025) , with continuous or ranked variants including recognition accuracy drop Li and Lyu (2019) ; Zhai et al. (2022) , cosine similarity Wen et al. (2022) ; Zhang et al. (2024) , identity distance Cao et al. (2023) ; Wen et al. (2023) , Rank- N N - T T Yang et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2025) , and AUC Meden et al. (2023) ; Proença (2022) ; Pan et al. (2024) , which differ in normalization and recognizer dependence. Utility preservation is typically tied to the attribute being evaluated, using categorical accuracy for expression Maximov et al. (2020) and classification or regression error for age and gender Gong et al. (2023) ; these protocols need annotations from different datasets (see Tab. 1 ). Image quality draws from reference-based metrics such as PSNR and SSIM Wang et al. (2004) , learned perceptual metrics such as LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018a) , and distributional metrics such as FID Heusel et al. (2017) . This proliferation of heterogeneous metrics and protocols impedes systematic comparison and reproducibility, while no existing metric provides a unified assessment across all three dimensions Wei et al. (2026b) . HiFD addresses both by adopting a consistency-based formulation and aggregating all three dimensions into a single interpretable score.
paragraphs.zh: FDeID 的评估涵盖三个维度：身份抑制、效用保留和图像质量，每个维度都积累了异质性的指标集合。 身份抑制最常用的报告方式是去标识成功率 Sharif et al. (2016)；Khorzooghi and Nilizadeh (2023)；Wang et al. (2024)；Liu et al. (2025b)；Salar et al. (2025)，其连续或排序变体包括识别准确率下降 Li and Lyu (2019)；Zhai et al. (2022)、余弦相似度 Wen et al. (2022)；Zhang et al. (2024)、身份距离 Cao et al. (2023)；Wen et al. (2023)、Rank-N N-TT Yang et al. (2021)；Wang et al. (2025)，以及 AUC Meden et al. (2023)；Proença (2022)；Pan et al. (2024)，这些指标在归一化和识别器依赖性方面存在差异。 效用保留通常与所评估的属性相关，使用分类准确率衡量表情 Maximov et al. (2020)，以及年龄和性别的分类或回归误差 Gong et al. (2023)；这些协议需要来自不同数据集的标注（见表 1）。 图像质量参考了基于参考的指标，如 PSNR 和 SSIM Wang et al. (2004)、学习到的感知指标，如 LPIPS Zhang et al. (2018a)，以及分布性指标，如 FID Heusel et al. (2017)。 异质性指标和协议的激增阻碍了系统性的比较和可重复性，而目前没有任何指标能够对所有三个维度提供统一的评估 Wei et al. (2026b)。 HiFD 通过采用基于一致性的公式，并将所有三个维度整合为一个可解释的单一分数，解决了这两个问题。

sents.en: HiFD addresses both by adopting a consistency-based formulation and aggregating all three dimensions into a single interpretable score.
sents.zh: HiFD 通过采用基于一致性的公式，并将所有三个维度整合为一个可解释的单一分数，解决了这两个问题。

paragraphs.en: Facial images encode abundant information spanning identity features and non-identity utility cues across multiple granularities. At the coarsest level, well-established tasks such as age estimation Geng et al. (2007) , gender classification Makinen and Raisamo (2008) , ethnicity recognition Karkkainen and Joo (2021) , expression recognition Li and Deng (2020) , and facial landmark detection Li et al. (2022) represent mature fields with established benchmarks and high-performing models; these macro-level signals are spatially coarse, semantically salient, and readily perceivable by human observers. At a finer level, micro-expressions Zhao et al. (2023) and gaze direction Cheng et al. (2024) capture subtle behavioral and attentional states that are critical for affective computing, deception detection, and human-computer interaction; these signals depend on precise localized geometry and temporal dynamics that are far more fragile under facial manipulation. At the finest level, deep learning approaches for rPPG, including DeepPhys Chen and McDuff (2018) , PhysNet Yu et al. (2019) , and EfficientPhys Liu et al. (2023) , now recover heart rate and physiological waveforms from sub-pixel skin color variations in face videos, with transformative potential for telehealth and remote patient monitoring.
paragraphs.zh: 面部图像编码了丰富的信息，涵盖身份特征和非身份的效用线索，且这些信息存在于多个粒度层次上。 在最粗的层次上，诸如年龄估计 Geng et al. (2007) 、性别分类 Makinen and Raisamo (2008) 、种族识别 Karkkainen and Joo (2021) 、表情识别 Li and Deng (2020) 以及面部关键点检测 Li et al. (2022) 等久经验证的任务，代表了拥有成熟基准和高性能模型的领域；这些宏观层面的信号在空间上较为粗略，语义上显著，且易于人类观察者感知。 在更精细的层次上，微表情 Zhao et al. (2023) 和注视方向 Cheng et al. (2024) 能够捕捉细微的行为与注意力状态，这些状态对于情感计算、欺骗检测和人机交互至关重要；而这些信号依赖于精确的局部几何结构和动态变化，在面部图像被篡改时则显得更为脆弱。 在最精细的层次上，用于 rPPG 的深度学习方法，包括 DeepPhys Chen and McDuff (2018) 、PhysNet Yu et al. (2019) 以及 EfficientPhys Liu et al. (2023) ，如今已从面部视频中的亚像素级肤色变化中恢复出心率和生理波形，为远程医疗和远程患者监测带来了变革性的潜力。

paragraphs.en: This natural stratification, from coarse attributes perceivable at a glance, through subtle behavioral dynamics, to physiological signals invisible to the naked eye, suggests an inherent hierarchy of facial signal that FDeID methods affect at different rates. Yet this hierarchical structure remains unexplored in FDeID evaluation. We formalize this observation and introduce a three-level utility framework that enables principled assessment of what facial information FDeID methods preserve or destroy.
paragraphs.zh: 这种自然分层——从一眼可辨的粗粒度特征，到微妙的行为动态，再到肉眼不可见的生理信号——表明面部信号存在一种内在层级结构，而FDeID方法对这一结构的影响速率各不相同。 然而，这种层级结构在FDeID评估中仍未被探索。 我们将这一观察结果形式化，并引入一个三级效用框架，从而能够基于原则性标准评估FDeID方法保留了哪些面部信息或破坏了哪些信息。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark suitable for comprehensive FDeID evaluation must simultaneously provide sufficient identity diversity for meaningful privacy evaluation, adequate image quality for reliable attribute estimation, and demographic balance to avoid evaluation bias. No existing face dataset satisfies these three requirements jointly (Tab. 1 ). We therefore design a four-stage curation pipeline that aggregates, cleans, enhances, and balances face images from four large-scale sources; a summary of each stage and its output statistics is reported in Tab. 2 , and full operational details (restoration-tool selection, identity-deduplication threshold, quality-filter justification) are deferred to Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 一个适合全面 FDeID 评估的基准数据集必须同时提供足够的身份多样性以实现有意义的隐私评估、足够高的图像质量以确保可靠的属性估计，以及人口统计学上的平衡性以避免评估偏差。 目前没有任何面部数据集能同时满足这三个要求（表 1）。 因此，我们设计了一个四阶段的数据整理流程，从四个大规模数据源中收集、清洗、增强并平衡面部图像；各阶段及其输出统计的摘要列于表 2，完整的操作细节（包括修复工具的选择、身份去重阈值以及质量过滤的依据）则详见附录 A。

sents.zh: 因此，我们设计了一个四阶段的数据整理流程，从四个大规模数据源中收集、清洗、增强并平衡面部图像；各阶段及其输出统计的摘要列于表 2，完整的操作细节（包括修复工具的选择、身份去重阈值以及质量过滤的依据）则详见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Source aggregation. We aggregate WebFace42M Zhu et al. (2021) , Glint360K An et al. (2021) , MS1MV2 Deng et al. (2019) , and MegaFace Kemelmacher-Shlizerman et al. (2016) , yielding an unfiltered pool of approximately 69.55 69.55 M images across 3.12 3.12 M identities. These datasets were originally curated to train robust face recognition models and thus contain substantial proportions of challenging samples (heavy blur, extreme pose, occlusion) that, while beneficial for recognition training, are unsuitable for utility-aware FDeID evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 数据聚合。我们将 WebFace42M（Zhu 等人，2021）、Glint360K（An 等人，2021）、MS1MV2（Deng 等人，2019）和 MegaFace（Kemelmacher-Shlizerman 等人，2016）进行聚合，得到了一个未经过滤的数据池，其中包含约 69.55 M 张图像，覆盖 3.12 M 个身份。这些数据集最初是为训练鲁棒的人脸识别模型而构建的，因此包含了大量具有挑战性的样本（严重模糊、极端姿态、遮挡）。尽管这些样本有助于人脸识别训练，但它们并不适合用于关注实用性的 FDeID 评估。

paragraphs.en: Identity-aware cleaning and resolution enhancement. We discard samples that would compromise downstream evaluation: images with zero or multiple detected faces, non-RGB inputs, heavily blurred samples, and cross-dataset duplicate identities identified via pretrained ArcFace Deng et al. (2019) similarity. Surviving low-resolution samples are upsampled to 448 × 448 448{\times}448 or 512 × 512 512{\times}512 using blind face restoration Wang et al. (2021) ; Zhou et al. (2022) , with the upsampling ratio capped at 4 × 4{\times} to preserve perceptual fidelity. This stage yields ∼ 20.58 \sim 20.58 M images across ∼ 701,810 \sim 701{,}810 identities.
paragraphs.zh: 身份感知清洗与分辨率增强。我们丢弃可能影响下游评估的样本：检测到零张或多张人脸的图像、非 RGB 输入、严重模糊的样本，以及通过预训练的 ArcFace Deng et al. (2019) 相似性检测出的跨数据集重复身份。保留下来的低分辨率样本使用盲面恢复方法 Wang et al. (2021)；Zhou et al. (2022) 上采样至 448 × 448 448{\times}448 或 512 × 512 512{\times}512，同时将对上采样率限制在 4 × 4{\times}，以保留感知保真度。此阶段共产生约 20.58 \sim 20.58 M 张图像，涵盖约 701,810 \sim 701{,}810 个身份。

paragraphs.en: Perceptual quality filtering. We apply a quality filter based on NIQE Mittal et al. (2012) , discarding images with NIQE ≥ 5.0 \text{NIQE}\geq 5.0 , an empirically motivated cut-off that admits naturalistic faces while rejecting restoration failures. The pool contains ∼ 8.69 \sim 8.69 M images across ∼ 640,035 \sim 640{,}035 identities after this stage.
paragraphs.zh: 感知质量过滤。我们应用基于 NIQE Mittal 等人（2012）研究的质量过滤器，丢弃 NIQE ≥ 5.0 \text{NIQE}\geq 5.0 的图像；该阈值基于经验设定，既能保留自然逼真的面部图像，又能排除修复失败的情况。经过此阶段后，图像池中包含了约 ∼ 8.69 \sim 8.69 M 张图像，涵盖约 ∼ 640,035 \sim 640{,}035 个身份。

paragraphs.en: Demographically balanced benchmark construction. The remaining pool exhibits strong distributional skew across gender, ethnicity, expression, pose, and age (Fig. 3 , grey bars), which would otherwise conflate method performance with demographic bias. We apply a hierarchical stratified sampling strategy operating at the identity level: identities are partitioned into 14 14 strata defined by gender and ethnicity, then ranked within each stratum by a composite score combining image count and diversity over expression and head pose. The top-ranked identities fill an equal per-stratum budget, and all images of each selected identity are retained. The resulting UtilFace benchmark contains 99,928 99{,}928 images across 2,069 2{,}069 identities (mean 48.3 48.3 , median 30 30 images per identity), with near-uniform gender balance ( 51.5 % 51.5\% / 48.5 % 48.5\% ) and a flattened ethnicity distribution that reduces the largest-to-smallest category ratio from 53 × 53\times to 2.3 × 2.3\times (Fig. 3 , teal bars).
paragraphs.zh: 人口统计学上均衡的基准数据集构建。 剩余的数据池在性别、种族、表情、姿势和年龄方面表现出明显的分布偏斜（图3，灰色条），否则这将导致方法性能与人口统计学偏见混为一谈。 我们采用一种在身份层面运作的分层抽样策略：将身份按性别和种族划分为14个分层，然后在每个分层内根据结合图像数量以及表情和头部姿势多样性的综合得分进行排序。 排名最高的身份会填满每个分层的配额，且每个被选中的身份的所有图像都会被保留。 最终得到的UtilFace基准数据集包含来自2,069个身份的99,928张图像（每个身份平均48.3张，中位数30张），性别分布接近均衡（51.5% / 48.5%），种族分布也趋于均匀，使得最大类别与最小类别的比例从53倍降至2.3倍（图3，青绿色条）。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the image datasets in Tab. 1 , UtilFace carries no attribute annotations by design: the consistency-based HiFD metric measures the consistency between estimator outputs on 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} , so ground-truth labels are neither needed nor desirable.

paragraphs.en: Evaluating FDeID requires jointly quantifying two competing objectives: how effectively identity is suppressed and how faithfully non-identity information is retained . Existing protocols report these objectives in isolation, treat utility as a monolithic concept, and often rely on ground-truth labels. We address these limitations with HiFD , a unified scalar metric that integrates identity suppression, hierarchical utility preservation, and image quality into a single interpretable score. HiFD adopts a consistency-based formulation throughout: every component is computed as the consistency between a pretrained estimator’s outputs on the original input and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying the amount of downstream-perceivable information that survives de-identification. We first define a generic consistency function, instantiate it on the three-level hierarchy, then specify privacy and quality, and combine all five into the composite HiFD score.
paragraphs.zh: 评估 FDeID 需要联合量化两个相互竞争的目标：身份信息的抑制效果以及非身份信息的保留程度。 现有协议分别报告这些目标，将效用视为一个整体概念，并且通常依赖真实标签。 我们通过 HiFD 解决了这些局限性，这是一种统一的标量指标，将身份抑制、分层效用保留和图像质量整合为单一的可解释分数。 HiFD 全程采用基于一致性的构建方式：每个组件都计算为预训练估计器在原始输入及其去标识化版本上的输出之间的一致性，从而直接量化去标识化过程中保留的下游可感知信息量。 我们首先定义一个通用的一致性函数，然后在三级层次结构上具体实现它，接着明确隐私性和质量指标，最后将这五个要素结合为复合的 HiFD 分数。

paragraphs.en: Consistency design principle. For the k k -th estimator with output space 𝒴 k \mathcal{Y}_{k} , a consistency function s k : 𝒴 k × 𝒴 k → [ 0 , 1 ] s_{k}:\mathcal{Y}_{k}\times\mathcal{Y}_{k}\rightarrow[0,1] takes the estimator’s outputs on the original face 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and its de-identified counterpart 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} and returns their agreement as a similarity score, with 1 1 indicating identical outputs. We require every s k s_{k} to satisfy: (i) boundedness , s k ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{k}\in[0,1] with s k = 1 s_{k}=1 when the outputs are identical; (ii) type-appropriateness , tailored to the output modality (scalar, categorical distribution, coordinate array, or temporal signal); (iii) graceful degradation , with a well-defined value at degenerate inputs. The metric does not require per-image ground-truth labels; the only quantities specified a priori are global normalization constants (attribute ranges, error caps) that are hand-defined once for each task, based on domain conventions. See details in Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 一致性设计原则。 对于第 k 个输出空间为 𝒴 k \mathcal{Y}_{k} 的估计器，一致性函数 s k : 𝒴 k × 𝒴 k → [ 0 , 1 ] s_{k}:\mathcal{Y}_{k}\times\mathcal{Y}_{k}\rightarrow[0,1] 接收该估计器在原始图像 𝐱 \mathbf{x} 上的输出及其去标识化对应版本 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}}，并返回二者的一致性作为相似性得分，其中 1 表示输出完全相同。 我们要求每个 s k 满足以下条件：(i) 有界性，s k ∈ [ 0 , 1 ]，当输出完全相同时 s k = 1；(ii) 类型适配性，需针对输出模态（标量、分类分布、坐标数组或时间信号）进行专门设计；(iii) 优雅降级，在退化输入下具有明确定义的值。 该度量无需每张图像的基准标签；唯一需要预先指定的量是全局归一化常数（属性范围、误差上限），这些常数为每个任务手动定义一次，依据领域惯例确定。 详见附录 B.1。

sents.en: Consistency design principle.
sents.zh: 一致性设计原则。

sents.en: For the k k -th estimator with output space 𝒴 k \mathcal{Y}_{k} , a consistency function s k : 𝒴 k × 𝒴 k → [ 0 , 1 ] s_{k}:\mathcal{Y}_{k}\times\mathcal{Y}_{k}\rightarrow[0,1] takes the estimator’s outputs on the original face 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and its de-identified counterpart 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} and returns their agreement as a similarity score, with 1 1 indicating identical outputs.
sents.zh: 对于第 k 个输出空间为 𝒴 k \mathcal{Y}_{k} 的估计器，一致性函数 s k : 𝒴 k × 𝒴 k → [ 0 , 1 ] s_{k}:\mathcal{Y}_{k}\times\mathcal{Y}_{k}\rightarrow[0,1] 接收该估计器在原始图像 𝐱 \mathbf{x} 上的输出及其去标识化对应版本 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}}，并返回二者的一致性作为相似性得分，其中 1 表示输出完全相同。

sents.en: We require every s k s_{k} to satisfy: (i) boundedness , s k ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{k}\in[0,1] with s k = 1 s_{k}=1 when the outputs are identical; (ii) type-appropriateness , tailored to the output modality (scalar, categorical distribution, coordinate array, or temporal signal); (iii) graceful degradation , with a well-defined value at degenerate inputs.
sents.zh: 我们要求每个 s k 满足以下条件：(i) 有界性，s k ∈ [ 0 , 1 ]，当输出完全相同时 s k = 1；(ii) 类型适配性，需针对输出模态（标量、分类分布、坐标数组或时间信号）进行专门设计；(iii) 优雅降级，在退化输入下具有明确定义的值。

sents.en: The metric does not require per-image ground-truth labels; the only quantities specified a priori are global normalization constants (attribute ranges, error caps) that are hand-defined once for each task, based on domain conventions.
sents.zh: 该度量无需每张图像的基准标签；唯一需要预先指定的量是全局归一化常数（属性范围、误差上限），这些常数为每个任务手动定义一次，依据领域惯例确定。

sents.zh: 详见附录 B.1。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical utility scores. We instantiate the principle above on the three-level hierarchy of Fig. 2 , yielding five L1, two L2, and two L3 consistency scores. L1 (macro-cues) covers age, gender, ethnicity, macro-expression, and landmark consistency, using truncated absolute error for scalars, total variation distance for categorical posterior distributions (with a top-1-plus-confidence binary posterior reconstructed for gender), and normalized mean error (NME) for landmark coordinates anchored on the inter-ocular distance of 𝐱 \mathbf{x} ; we aggregate into U 1 U_{1} by unweighted averaging. L2 (micro-cues) covers gaze and micro-expression consistency, aggregated into U 2 U_{2} as the mean when video is available and as s gaze s_{\text{gaze}} alone for image-only inputs. L3 (imperceptible cues) covers blood-volume-pulse (BVP) and heart-rate (HR) consistency from rPPG signals, aggregated into U 3 U_{3} after averaging over an ensemble of rPPG estimators (PhysNet Yu et al. (2019) , EfficientPhys Liu et al. (2023) , FactorizePhys Joshi et al. (2024) ). BVP uses a positive-correlation rescaling that assigns zero consistency to uncorrelated or anti-correlated pairs, and HR uses a tightened cap of τ HR = 20 \tau_{\text{HR}}=20 bpm to match the clinical relevance threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 层级效用得分。 我们将上述原则应用于图2中的三级层级结构，从而得到五个L1一致性得分、两个L2一致性和两个L3一致性得分。 L1（宏观线索）涵盖年龄、性别、种族、宏观表情和地标一致性：标量值使用截断绝对误差，分类后验分布使用总变差距离（其中性别采用“前1名+置信度”的二元后验重构），地标坐标则使用以𝐱 \mathbf{x} 的双眼间距为锚点的归一化平均误差（NME）；我们通过不加权平均将其汇总为U 1 U_{1}。 L2（微观线索）涵盖注视和微表情一致性：在有视频输入时，通过取平均值汇总为U 2 U_{2}；对于仅含图像的输入，则仅使用s gaze s_{\text{gaze}}进行汇总。 L3（不可察觉的线索）涵盖来自rPPG信号的血液体积脉动（BVP）和心率（HR）一致性：通过对一组rPPG估计器（PhysNet Yu et al. (2019) 、EfficientPhys Liu et al. (2023) 、FactorizePhys Joshi et al. (2024) ）进行平均后，汇总为U 3 U_{3}。 BVP采用正相关重缩放方法，对无相关性或负相关的配对分配零一致性；HR则采用τ HR = 20 \tau_{\text{HR}}=20 bpm的更严格上限，以匹配临床相关的阈值。

paragraphs.en: Properties. By construction, HiFD satisfies: (i) boundedness , HiFD ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \text{{HiFD}}\in[0,1] ; (ii) monotonicity , improving any component increases the score; (iii) vetoing , the harmonic mean drives the score toward zero when any single component approaches zero; (iv) graceful degradation across modalities via L L ; (v) annotation-free , every component depends only on estimator outputs on 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} .
paragraphs.zh: 属性。 根据构造，HiFD 满足：(i) 有界性，HiFD ∈ [0, 1]；(ii) 单调性，改进任何组件都会提高得分；(iii) 否决性，当任何单个组件趋近于零时，调和平均值会将得分推向零；(iv) 通过 L L 实现跨模态的优雅降级；(v) 无需标注，每个组件仅依赖于对 𝐱 和 𝐱 ^ 的估计器输出。

paragraphs.en: FDeID methods. We evaluate 12 representative methods spanning the three dominant FDeID paradigms based on their underlying generation mechanism. (i) Adversarial perturbation , which applies ε \varepsilon -bounded gradient-based noise to fool face recognition models: MI-FGSM Dong et al. (2018) , PGD Madry et al. (2018) , TI-DIM Dong et al. (2019) , TIP-IM Yang et al. (2021) , and Chameleon Chow et al. (2024) . (ii) GAN-based generation , which produces anonymized images via a learned generator trained with adversarial objectives: CIAGAN Maximov et al. (2020) for identity-conditioned replacement, AMT-GAN Hu et al. (2022) for adversarial makeup transfer, Adv-Makeup Yin et al. (2021) for eye-region makeup, DeID-rPPG Savic and Zhao (2023) for heart-rate preservation, and G 2 Face Yang et al. (2024) for geometry and expression preservation. (iii) Diffusion-based generation , represented by DiffAM Sun et al. (2024) and WeakenDiff Salar et al. (2025) , anonymizes faces through iterative denoising sampling.
paragraphs.zh: FDeID 方法。 我们基于其底层生成机制，评估了涵盖三种主流 FDeID 范式的 12 种代表性方法。 (i) 对抗性扰动，通过施加 ε \varepsilon -有界的基于梯度的噪声来欺骗人脸识别模型：MI-FGSM Dong 等人 (2018)、PGD Madry 等人 (2018)、TI-DIM Dong 等人 (2019)、TIP-IM Yang 等人 (2021)，以及 Chameleon Chow 等人 (2024)。 (ii) GAN 基生成，通过用对抗性目标训练的生成器生成匿名化图像：CIAGAN Maximov 等人 (2020) 用于身份条件替换，AMT-GAN Hu 等人 (2022) 用于对抗性妆容迁移，Adv-Makeup Yin 等人 (2021) 用于眼部区域妆容，DeID-rPPG Savic 和 Zhao (2023) 用于心率保留，以及 G 2 Face Yang 等人 (2024) 用于几何形状和表情保留。 (iii) 扩散基生成，以 DiffAM Sun 等人 (2024) 和 WeakenDiff Salar 等人 (2025) 为代表，通过迭代去噪采样对人脸进行匿名化。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. All privacy, L1 attributes, L2 gaze, and quality metrics are computed on UtilFace ( 99,928 99{,}928 images, 2,069 2{,}069 identities). L2 micro-expression is evaluated on DFME Zhao et al. (2023) test-set A ( 474 474 video clips). L3 rPPG is evaluated on PURE Stricker et al. (2014) ( 10 10 subjects, 60 60 video clips). Additionally, we use RAF-DB Li et al. (2017) and MMPD Tang et al. (2023) for the HiFD validation.

paragraphs.en: Estimators. Every score in HiFD is a consistency score between a pretrained estimator’s outputs on the original and the de-identified input. Privacy uses an ensemble of ArcFace Deng et al. (2019) , CosFace Wang et al. (2018) , and AdaFace Kim et al. (2022) face recognizers, with face bounding boxes and 5-point landmarks cached once on the original via RetinaFace Deng et al. (2020) and reused on the de-identified counterparts for consistent alignment. L1 : age and gender via MiVOLO Kuprashevich and Tolstykh (2023) (trained on UTKFace), ethnicity via FairFace Karkkainen and Joo (2021) , macro-expression via POSTER Zheng et al. (2023) (trained on RAF-DB), and 68-point facial landmarks via MediaPipe Lugaresi et al. (2019) Face Landmarker. L2 : gaze estimation via L2CS-Net Abdelrahman et al. (2023) (trained on Gaze360 Kellnhofer et al. (2019) ), and micro-expression via SAMER Ruan et al. (2022) (five-class). L3 : BVP waveforms via PhysNet Yu et al. (2019) , EfficientPhys Liu et al. (2023) , and FactorizePhys Joshi et al. (2024) (all trained on UBFC-rPPG dataset). Quality : LPIPS-VGG Zhang et al. (2018a) and NIQE Mittal et al. (2012) computed via pyiqa .
paragraphs.zh: 估计器。HiFD 中的每个分数都是预训练估计器在原始输入和去标识化输入上的输出之间的一致性分数。隐私保护部分使用了一个由 ArcFace Deng et al. (2019)、CosFace Wang et al. (2018) 和 AdaFace Kim et al. (2022) 人脸识别器组成的集成模型，其中人脸边界框和 5 个关键点通过 RetinaFace Deng et al. (2020) 在原始输入上缓存一次，并在去标识化输入上重复使用，以实现一致的对齐。L1：通过 MiVOLO Kuprashevich and Tolstykh (2023)（在 UTKFace 上训练）获取年龄和性别，通过 FairFace Karkkainen and Joo (2021) 获取种族，通过 POSTER Zheng et al. (2023)（在 RAF-DB 上训练）获取宏观表情，以及通过 MediaPipe Lugaresi et al. (2019) Face Landmarker 获取 68 个面部关键点。L2：通过 L2CS-Net Abdelrahman et al. (2023)（在 Gaze360 Kellnhofer et al. (2019) 上训练）进行注视估计，以及通过 SAMER Ruan et al. (2022)（五类）进行微表情分析。L3：通过 PhysNet Yu et al. (2019)、EfficientPhys Liu et al. (2023) 和 FactorizePhys Joshi et al. (2024)（均在 UBFC-rPPG 数据集上训练）获取 BVP 波形。质量：通过 pyiqa 计算 LPIPS-VGG Zhang et al. (2018a) 和 NIQE Mittal et al. (2012)。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. All inference and scoring runs on 8 AMD MI250X GPUs. HiFD components are aggregated per method (privacy and per-image sub-scores as mean over 99,928 99{,}928 keys; rPPG as mean over 60 clips × \times 3 3 estimators; micro-expression as mean over 474 clips) and combined via the weighted harmonic mean in Eq. ( 1 ). Unless otherwise noted, we report the Balanced profile ( w P = w Q = w 1 = w 2 = w 3 w_{P}=w_{Q}=w_{1}=w_{2}=w_{3} ). Normalization caps follow § 3.2 : Δ age = 100 \Delta_{\text{age}}=100 , τ NME = 0.10 \tau_{\text{NME}}=0.10 , θ max = 90 ∘ \theta_{\max}=90^{\circ} , τ HR = 20 \tau_{\text{HR}}=20 bpm, τ N = 5 \tau_{\text{N}}=5 , α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 . See Appendix for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 所有推理和评分运行均在 8 块 AMD MI250X GPU 上进行。 HiFD 各组件按方法汇总（隐私性和每张图像的子分数取 99,928 个键的平均值；rPPG 取 60 个片段 × 3 个估计器的平均值；微表情取 474 个片段的平均值），并通过公式 (1) 中的加权调和平均进行结合。 除非另有说明，否则我们报告的是平衡配置文件（wP = wQ = w1 = w2 = w3）。 归一化上限遵循 §3.2：Δage = 100、τNME = 0.10、θmax = 90°、τHR = 20 bpm、τN = 5、α = 0.5。 更多细节请参见附录。

paragraphs.en: Finding 1: The privacy-utility frontier is not monotonic across paradigms. No FDeID family dominates on both axes and each trades privacy for utility on its own terms. Adversarial methods retain the highest macro-cue scores ( U 1 > 0.92 U_{1}>0.92 for PGD and MI-FGSM), as expected from their minimally visible pixel perturbations, but only the two with explicit transferability objectives reach P ¯ ≈ 0.50 \bar{P}\approx 0.50 (TI-DIM, TIP-IM). MI-FGSM and PGD stall at P ¯ < 0.14 \bar{P}<0.14 , suggesting that recent robust recognizers largely survive naive gradient attacks; in operational terms they de-identify only 8 % 8\% of faces at any false-accept rate (Appendix C.2 ). GAN methods cover the widest privacy range: CIAGAN reaches P ¯ = 0.45 \bar{P}=0.45 by replacing the face entirely, but at severe cost on U 1 U_{1} ( 0.47 0.47 ) and landmarks ( 0.08 0.08 ), while cosmetic methods such as Adv-Makeup preserve macro-cues almost perfectly yet offer virtually no identity suppression ( P ¯ = 0.01 \bar{P}=0.01 ). Diffusion methods sit between these extremes. WeakenDiff achieves P ¯ = 0.22 \bar{P}=0.22 and U 1 = 0.83 U_{1}=0.83 . DiffAM, despite its explicit adversarial-makeup objective, scores only P ¯ = 0.16 \bar{P}=0.16 on our ArcFace/CosFace/AdaFace ensemble, since its makeup perturbations were trained against IRSE50/IR152/MobileFace/FaceNet and transfer imperfectly to modern recognizers. DiffAM nonetheless outperforms WeakenDiff on U 2 U_{2} , U 3 U_{3} , and Q Q ( 0.81 0.81 , 0.56 0.56 , 0.47 0.47 ) and trails only marginally on U 1 U_{1} ( 0.79 0.79 vs. 0.83 0.83 ), yielding a higher HiFD of 0.394 0.394 versus 0.332 0.332 .
paragraphs.zh: 发现 1：隐私-效用边界在不同范式下并非单调变化。 没有任何 FDeID 族在两个轴上都占据主导地位，每个族都按照自身规则在隐私与效用之间进行权衡。 对抗性方法保留了最高的宏观特征分数（PGD 和 MI-FGSM 的 U₁ > 0.92），这与其像素扰动几乎不可见的特点相符；但只有两个具有明确可迁移性目标的方法达到了 P̄ ≈ 0.50（TI-DIM、TIP-IM）。 MI-FGSM 和 PGD 在 P̄ < 0.14 处停滞，这表明近期的鲁棒识别器在很大程度上能够抵御简单的梯度攻击；从实际运行角度来看，在任何误接受率下，它们仅能去识别 8% 的人脸（附录 C.2）。 GAN 方法覆盖了最广泛的隐私范围：CIAGAN 通过完全替换人脸实现了 P̄ = 0.45，但严重牺牲了 U₁（0.47）和地标特征（0.08）；而像 Adv-Makeup 这类修饰性方法几乎完美地保留了宏观特征，却几乎没有提供任何身份抑制能力（P̄ = 0.01）。 扩散方法介于上述两种极端之间。 WeakenDiff 实现了 P̄ = 0.22 和 U₁ = 0.83。 尽管 DiffAM 具有明确的对抗性修饰目标，但在我们的 ArcFace/CosFace/AdaFace 集成模型上仅获得了 P̄ = 0.16，因为其修饰扰动是在 IRSE50/IR152/MobileFace/FaceNet 上训练的，无法完美迁移到现代识别器中。 尽管如此，DiffAM 在 U₂、U₃ 和 Q（0.81、0.56、0.47）方面优于 WeakenDiff，且仅在 U₁ 上略逊一筹（0.79 对比 0.83），从而获得了更高的 HiFD（0.394 对比 0.332）。

paragraphs.en: Finding 2: Hierarchical signals degrade at different rates. Preservation drops from L1 to L3 for almost every method, with the steepest collapse in generative families. AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, G 2 Face, and WeakenDiff all score U 3 < 0.33 U_{3}<0.33 , confirming that face synthesis decouples macro appearance from fine-grained skin-color dynamics. Adversarial methods preserve U 3 U_{3} best (TIP-IM 0.62 0.62 , Chameleon 0.80 0.80 ), since bounded ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} or ℓ 2 \ell_{2} noise leaves low-frequency skin signals largely intact. Only Adv-Makeup ( U 3 = 0.93 U_{3}\!=\!0.93 ) and DeID-rPPG ( U 3 = 0.91 U_{3}\!=\!0.91 ) combine high U 3 U_{3} with high U 1 U_{1} , but both trade this preservation for a complete loss of identity suppression.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 2：层级信号以不同速率退化。 几乎所有方法在 L1 到 L3 之间的保留率均下降，其中生成模型家族的下降最为剧烈。 AMT-GAN、CIAGAN、G 2 Face 和 WeakenDiff 的 U 3 < 0.33，证实了面部合成将宏观外观与精细的皮肤颜色动态分离开来。 对抗性方法对 U 3 的保留效果最好（TIP-IM 为 0.62，Chameleon 为 0.80），因为受限的 ℓ ∞ 或 ℓ 2 噪声使低频皮肤信号基本保持完整。 只有 Adv-Makeup（U 3 = 0.93）和 DeID-rPPG（U 3 = 0.91）同时实现了较高的 U 3 和 U 1，但两者都以完全丧失身份抑制为代价换取了这种保留效果。

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: Hierarchical preservation is asymmetrically coupled. Does retaining the strictest level U 3 U_{3} imply retention of U 2 U_{2} and U 1 U_{1} , and conversely? Fig. 5 answers across the 12 methods. The parallel-coordinates panel (left) shows the polylines fanning out from U 1 U_{1} to U 3 U_{3} : nine of the twelve methods exceed 0.80 0.80 on U 1 U_{1} and nine on U 2 U_{2} , yet only Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG sit above U 3 = 0.90 U_{3}\!=\!0.90 , while AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, WeakenDiff, and G 2 Face fall below U 3 = 0.35 U_{3}\!=\!0.35 . The conditional preservation matrix (right) quantifies the implication structure at threshold τ = 0.80 \tau\!=\!0.80 : every method that preserves U 3 U_{3} also preserves U 1 U_{1} and U 2 U_{2} ( Pr ⁡ ( U 1 ≥ τ | U 3 ≥ τ ) = Pr ⁡ ( U 2 ≥ τ | U 3 ≥ τ ) = 1.00 \Pr(U_{1}\!\geq\!\tau\,|\,U_{3}\!\geq\!\tau)=\Pr(U_{2}\!\geq\!\tau\,|\,U_{3}\!\geq\!\tau)=1.00 ), yet only 22 % 22\% (two of nine) of the methods that preserve U 1 U_{1} also preserve U 3 U_{3} ; the asymmetry holds for every τ ∈ [ 0.70 , 0.90 ] \tau\in[0.70,0.90] . Practically, the asymmetry refutes the common shortcut of certifying L3 preservation by inspecting macro cues alone. This is precisely what the harmonic-mean aggregation enforces via the vetoing property: a near-zero U 3 U_{3} component cannot be masked by strong U 1 U_{1} scores, so methods are ranked by their weakest dimension rather than their average. TIP-IM achieves the highest HiFD of 0.607 0.607 for this reason: it is the only method that reaches at least 0.44 0.44 on every dimension simultaneously, while specialized methods such as DeID-rPPG ( U 3 = 0.91 U_{3}\!=\!0.91 ) and G 2 Face ( U 1 = 0.81 U_{1}\!=\!0.81 ) excel on a single axis but do not dominate the composite.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 3：层级保留存在非对称耦合。 保留最严格的层级 U 3 U_{3} 是否意味着也保留了 U 2 U_{2} 和 U 1 U_{1}，反之亦然？ 图 5 在 12 种方法中给出了答案。 平行坐标图（左侧）显示了从 U 1 U_{1} 到 U 3 U_{3} 发散的多条折线：12 种方法中有 9 种在 U 1 U_{1} 上的值超过 0.80，9 种在 U 2 U_{2} 上也是如此，但只有 Adv-Makeup 和 DeID-rPPG 超过了 U 3 = 0.90 U_{3}\!=\!0.90，而 AMT-GAN、CIAGAN、WeakenDiff 和 G 2 Face 则低于 U 3 = 0.35 U_{3}\!=\!0.35。 条件保留矩阵（右侧）量化了阈值 τ = 0.80 \tau\!=\!0.80 下的蕴含结构：所有保留 U 3 U_{3} 的方法也都保留了 U 1 U_{1} 和 U 2 U_{2}（Pr⁡(U_{1}≥τ|U_{3}≥τ)=Pr⁡(U_{2}≥τ|U_{3}≥τ)=1.00 \Pr(U_{1}\!\geq\!\tau\,|\,U_{3}\!\geq\!\tau)=\Pr(U_{2}\!\geq\!\tau\,|\,U_{3}\!\geq\!\tau)=1.00），但仅有 22%（9 种方法中的 2 种）保留 U 1 U_{1} 的方法也保留了 U 3 U_{3}；这种非对称性在 τ ∈ [0.70, 0.90] \tau\in[0.70,0.90] 的每个阈值下均成立。 从实践角度看，这种非对称性推翻了仅通过检查宏观线索来验证 L3 保留的常见捷径。 这正是谐波均值聚合通过否决特性所强制实现的：接近零的 U 3 U_{3} 成分无法被较高的 U 1 U_{1} 分数掩盖，因此方法的排名依据其最弱维度而非平均值。 正因如此，TIP-IM 实现了最高的 HiFD（0.607 0.607）：它是唯一能在所有维度上同时达到至少 0.44 0.44 的方法，而 DeID-rPPG（U 3 = 0.91 U_{3}\!=\!0.91）和 G 2 Face（U 1 = 0.81 U_{1}\!=\!0.81）等专用方法虽在单一轴上表现优异，却未能主导综合指标。

sents.en: Finding 3: Hierarchical preservation is asymmetrically coupled.
sents.zh: 发现 3：层级保留存在非对称耦合。

sents.en: The parallel-coordinates panel (left) shows the polylines fanning out from U 1 U_{1} to U 3 U_{3} : nine of the twelve methods exceed 0.80 0.80 on U 1 U_{1} and nine on U 2 U_{2} , yet only Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG sit above U 3 = 0.90 U_{3}\!=\!0.90 , while AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, WeakenDiff, and G 2 Face fall below U 3 = 0.35 U_{3}\!=\!0.35 .

sents.en: Practically, the asymmetry refutes the common shortcut of certifying L3 preservation by inspecting macro cues alone.
sents.zh: 从实践角度看，这种非对称性推翻了仅通过检查宏观线索来验证 L3 保留的常见捷径。

sents.en: This is precisely what the harmonic-mean aggregation enforces via the vetoing property: a near-zero U 3 U_{3} component cannot be masked by strong U 1 U_{1} scores, so methods are ranked by their weakest dimension rather than their average.
sents.zh: 这正是谐波均值聚合通过否决特性所强制实现的：接近零的 U 3 U_{3} 成分无法被较高的 U 1 U_{1} 分数掩盖，因此方法的排名依据其最弱维度而非平均值。

sents.zh: 正因如此，TIP-IM 实现了最高的 HiFD（0.607 0.607）：它是唯一能在所有维度上同时达到至少 0.44 0.44 的方法，而 DeID-rPPG（U 3 = 0.91 U_{3}\!=\!0.91）和 G 2 Face（U 1 = 0.81 U_{1}\!=\!0.81）等专用方法虽在单一轴上表现优异，却未能主导综合指标。

paragraphs.en: Finding 4: Application-specific profiles reshape the ranking. Tab. 5 reports HiFD under the three profiles defined in § 3.2 . Under Privacy-First ( w P = 0.5 w_{P}\!=\!0.5 ), CIAGAN rises within the GAN family thanks to its strong identity suppression, yet TIP-IM still leads overall because its balanced profile avoids any near-zero component. Under Clinical ( w 3 = 0.4 w_{3}\!=\!0.4 ), adversarial methods (TIP-IM, Chameleon) dominate as they retain physiological rPPG signals, while most GAN-based methods collapse since their face synthesis destroys sub-pixel dynamics regardless of visual fidelity. Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG remain at the bottom across all profiles: despite excellent utility preservation, their near-zero identity suppression ( P ¯ < 0.02 \bar{P}<0.02 ) is mathematically penalized by the harmonic-mean aggregation. The optimal FDeID choice therefore depends on which utility levels the downstream application prioritizes, but no profile rescues a method that fails on identity suppression.

paragraphs.en: Finding 5: FDeID methods are largely demographic-agnostic, with adversarial methods showing the largest disparities. Fig. 6 decomposes each method’s HiFD score across two genders and seven ethnicities. Across all 12 methods, no single method shows a per-gender gap larger than 0.035 0.035 or a seven-way ethnicity range larger than 0.064 0.064 , both an order of magnitude below the inter-method spread in Tab. 5 . The four methods with the widest per-method ethnicity range, PGD ( 0.064 0.064 ), Chameleon ( 0.050 0.050 ), MI-FGSM ( 0.049 0.049 ), and DiffAM ( 0.039 0.039 ), are all gradient-based or makeup-style perturbations that depend on local skin-tone gradients, which plausibly explains why they treat East Asian samples slightly differently from the rest. The top-ranked TIP-IM (gender gap 0.006 0.006 , ethnicity range 0.014 0.014 ) and the bottom-ranked Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG (disparities ≤ 0.021 \leq\!0.021 ) confirm that neither leadership nor failure is concentrated on any subgroup. The results demonstrate that current FDeID methods, despite spanning three different generation paradigms, do not exhibit the demographic-specific failure modes that have been documented for face recognition itself. The dominant axis of variation in FDeID quality is the choice of method, not the identity of the subject.

paragraphs.en: Every HiFD component is a consistency score , computed from a pretrained estimator’s outputs on 𝐱 \mathbf{x} and 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} without any label. Its validity therefore rests on two questions: does the consistency score track true utility preservation, and does the privacy score correspond to an operational notion of privacy? Fig. 7 places the consistency score next to a ground-truth score for every method, using ground truth that is available outside UtilFace . For macro-expression (Fig. 7 a) we de-identified the labeled RAF-DB test set ( 3,068 3{,}068 images) with all twelve methods and compared the consistency score with the fraction of ground-truth accuracy the same estimator retains on the de-identified images: the two bars differ by at most 0.06 0.06 for every method, both place CIAGAN far below the rest, and both agree on the three best-preserving methods. Per image, the consistency score predicts whether the true label survives with AUC 0.98 0.98 over 28,614 28{,}614 pairs, and only 1.1 % 1.1\% of pairs with a consistency score above 0.8 0.8 hide a flipped label. For rPPG (Fig. 7 b), MMPD’s contact sensor gives the true heart rate, so the ground-truth bar is the fraction of heart-rate accuracy retained after de-identification. The two scores live on different scales, because heart-rate error saturates, but they order the methods the same way: the same three best (Adv-Makeup, DeID-rPPG, Chameleon, whose de-identification raises the true error by under 1 1 bpm) and the same three worst (AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, WeakenDiff, by 4.5 4.5 to 7.4 7.4 bpm), with eleven of twelve methods within one rank of each other. A consistency score can still mislead for near-tie posteriors, which flip the hard label under an arbitrarily small total-variation change, or for an estimator that is degenerate on the de-identified domain. The first is why we measured hidden flips, and the second is bounded by estimator substitution (Appendix C.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个 HiFD 组件都是一个一致性分数，该分数基于预训练估计器对 𝐱 \mathbf{x} 和 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} 的输出计算得出，且无需任何标签。 因此，其有效性取决于两个问题：一致性分数是否反映了真实的效用保留情况，以及隐私分数是否对应于一种可操作的隐私概念？ 图 7 将每种方法的一致性分数与基准真实值分数并列展示，其中使用的基准真实值数据在 UtilFace 之外可用。 对于宏表情（图 7 a），我们使用全部十二种方法对带标签的 RAF-DB 测试集（3,068 张图像）进行了去标识化，并将一致性分数与同一估计器在去标识化图像上保留的基准真实值准确率比例进行比较：对于每种方法，这两根柱状图的差异最多为 0.06；两者都将 CIAGAN 排在远低于其他方法的位置，并且都一致认可三种最佳保留效果的方法。 按单张图像计算，一致性分数能够以 0.98 的 AUC 预测真实标签是否保留（基于 28,614 对图像），且仅有 1.1% 的一致性分数高于 0.8 的图像对存在标签翻转的情况。 对于 rPPG（图 7 b），MMPD 的接触传感器可提供真实心率，因此基准真实值柱状图表示去标识化后保留的心率准确率比例。 这两个分数的量纲不同，因为心率误差会达到饱和点，但它们对方法的排序一致：最佳方法相同（Adv-Makeup、DeID-rPPG、Chameleon，其去标识化操作使真实误差增加不到 1 bpm），最差方法也相同（AMT-GAN、CIAGAN、WeakenDiff，误差增加 4.5 至 7.4 bpm），且十二种方法中有十一种在排名上彼此相差一位以内。 对于后验概率接近相等的情况，一致性分数仍可能产生误导，因为此时极小的总变差变化就可能导致硬标签翻转；或者当估计器在去标识化域上出现退化时，也可能导致误判。 前者是我们测量隐藏标签翻转的原因，而后者则受到估计器替换的约束（附录 C.4）。

paragraphs.en: For privacy (Fig. 7 c) we fit verification thresholds on 3M different-identity impostor pairs and measure de-identification success, the fraction of faces no longer verified as their original. The bars show what P ¯ \bar{P} means in practice: the three methods with P ¯ ≥ 0.45 \bar{P}\geq 0.45 (TI-DIM, TIP-IM, CIAGAN) de-identify 93 93 to 96 % 96\% of faces at FAR 10 − 3 10^{-3} , the seven methods with P ¯ \bar{P} between 0.11 0.11 and 0.24 0.24 de-identify at most 27 % 27\% (three of them under 1 % 1\% ), and the two with P ¯ ≈ 0.01 \bar{P}\approx 0.01 de-identify none. Within the middle band the mapping is not monotone (MI-FGSM and PGD reach 8 % 8\% at P ¯ ≈ 0.12 \bar{P}\approx 0.12 while WeakenDiff stays below 1 % 1\% at 0.22 0.22 ), which is what a continuous embedding margin produces when it meets a thresholded decision. The practitioner-level reading is nevertheless unambiguous: only three of twelve methods de-identify usefully. Extended evaluations are detailed in Appendix C and E .

paragraphs.en: Our comparative study delivers a sobering answer: under the unified HiFD protocol, no current FDeID method is simultaneously private and utility-preserving across all three hierarchical levels. The best-performing method in our study, TIP-IM, attains a HiFD of only 0.607 0.607 , meaning that even the strongest baseline leaves a measurable gap on at least one of the five axes ( P ¯ , Q , U 1 , U 2 , U 3 \bar{P},Q,U_{1},U_{2},U_{3} ); every other method we evaluate scores below 0.52 0.52 . The privacy axis itself is the most fragile: nine of the twelve methods achieve P ¯ < 0.30 \bar{P}<0.30 against our three-recognizer ensemble, and only three de-identify more than 80 % 80\% of faces at a false-accept rate of 10 − 2 10^{-2} (Tab. 8 ), indicating that perceived “privacy” in much of the prior literature reflects evaluation against a single, often outdated recognizer rather than genuine identity suppression against modern systems. When privacy is achieved, it is typically purchased at a steep and uneven cost across the hierarchy, with macro cues (L1) most often retained, micro cues (L2) partially degraded, and physiological signals (L3) silently destroyed by virtually all generative approaches regardless of their visual fidelity. Consequently, we argue that future FDeID research should report HiFD alongside its constituent components rather than any single privacy or utility number in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的比较研究得出了一个令人警醒的结论：在统一的 HiFD 协议下，目前没有任何一种 FDeID 方法能同时在所有三个层级上兼顾隐私性和效用性。 我们研究中表现最佳的方法 TIP-IM 实现的 HiFD 仅为 0.607，这意味着即便是最强的基线方法，在五个维度（P ¯ ,Q,U_{1},U_{2},U_{3}）中至少有一个维度仍存在可测量的差距；我们评估的其他所有方法得分均低于 0.52。 隐私性维度本身最为脆弱：在我们采用的三种识别器集成模型下，十二种方法中有九种的 P ¯ < 0.30，而仅有三种方法能在 10^{-2} 的误接受率下对超过 80% 的面部进行去标识（见第 8 表）。这表明，以往文献中所谓的“隐私性”更多反映的是基于单一、且往往过时的识别器进行的评估，而非针对现代系统的真实身份抑制能力。 即便实现了隐私保护，通常也需要在层级结构中付出高昂且不均衡的代价：宏观特征（L1）大多得以保留，微观特征（L2）部分退化，而生理信号（L3）则几乎被所有生成式方法悄无声息地摧毁，无论其视觉保真度如何。 因此，我们认为未来的 FDeID 研究应当报告 HiFD 及其各组成成分的具体表现，而非孤立地仅报告单一的隐私性或效用性指标。

paragraphs.en: We presented UtilFace and HiFD , a paired benchmark and hierarchical metric for face de-identification. UtilFace is a curated, demographically balanced corpus assembled from four large-scale sources. HiFD unifies identity suppression, three-level utility preservation, and image quality into a single consistency-based score, computed without per-image attribute annotations. A comparative study over 12 12 representative methods spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based families surfaces trade-offs invisible to existing protocols: hierarchical signals degrade asymmetrically, with macro cues mostly retained, micro cues partially degraded, and physiological rPPG silently destroyed by virtually all generative approaches; most adversarial methods, once evaluated against an ensemble of modern recognizers, exhibit limited identity suppression; and no current method is simultaneously private and utility-preserving across all three levels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 UtilFace 和 HiFD，这是一对用于面部去身份识别的基准数据集和分层评估指标。 UtilFace 是一个经过精心整理、人口统计学特征均衡的数据集，由四个大规模数据源整合而成。 HiFD 将身份信息抑制、三级效用保留和图像质量统一为一个基于一致性的单一评分，且无需对每张图像的特定属性进行标注即可计算。 通过对涵盖对抗性、GAN 基和扩散模型等 12 种代表性方法的对比研究，我们发现了一些现有评估协议无法揭示的权衡关系：分层特征会呈现非对称退化——宏观特征大多得以保留，微观特征部分受损，而生理 rPPG 信号则几乎被所有生成式方法无声破坏；大多数对抗性方法在结合现代识别器集成进行评估后，其身份抑制效果有限；目前尚无任何方法能同时在所有三个层级上实现隐私保护与效用保留。

paragraphs.en: Limitation. HiFD is consistency-based, so its validity rests on the pretrained estimators used to compute each consistency score, and any bias of these estimators is inherited by HiFD . Ensembling for P ¯ \bar{P} and U 3 U_{3} and the substitution study of Appendix C.4 bound this dependence but do not remove it: the released protocol scores L1 and L2 with one estimator per attribute, and improvements in the underlying models will translate directly into more faithful scores.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 HiFD 基于一致性，因此其有效性取决于用于计算每个一致性分数的预训练估计器，而这些估计器的任何偏差都会被 HiFD 继承。 对 P ¯ \bar{P} 和 U 3 U_{3} 的集成方法以及附录 C.4 中的替换研究限制了这种依赖性，但并未消除它：发布的协议分数 L1 和 L2 每个属性使用一个估计器，而底层模型的改进将直接转化为更准确的分数。

paragraphs.en: This section completes § 3.1 with the operational details deferred for space: per-source statistics, the identity-deduplication threshold, the pose-conditioned routing between GFPGAN and CodeFormer, the empirical NIQE < < 5.0 cut-off, the composite ranking driving hierarchical stratified sampling, and source-dataset licenses.

paragraphs.en: We aggregate four large-scale face recognition datasets, summarized in Tab. 4 . These datasets differ substantially in scale, identity count, and image-per-identity ratio, which motivates the aggregation: no single source provides the combination of identity diversity and image coverage required for reliable privacy evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们整合了四个大规模人脸识别数据集，具体信息汇总于表 4。 这些数据集在规模、身份数量以及每身份图像比例方面存在显著差异，这也是整合这些数据集的原因：没有任何单一数据源能够提供可靠隐私评估所需的身份多样性和图像覆盖度的组合。

sents.en: We aggregate four large-scale face recognition datasets, summarized in Tab. 4 .
sents.zh: 我们整合了四个大规模人脸识别数据集，具体信息汇总于表 4。

sents.en: These datasets differ substantially in scale, identity count, and image-per-identity ratio, which motivates the aggregation: no single source provides the combination of identity diversity and image coverage required for reliable privacy evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We discard samples that would compromise downstream evaluation through four criteria: (i) images with zero or multiple detected faces, which introduce annotation ambiguity; (ii) non-RGB images ( e.g. , grayscale, infrared), which are incompatible with color-dependent estimators, in particular rPPG; (iii) heavily blurred images, particularly prevalent in WebFace42M; (iv) cross-dataset duplicate identities, identified by computing pairwise cosine similarities between per-identity mean embeddings from a pretrained ArcFace model Deng et al. (2019) from the InsightFace library. Identity pairs whose cosine similarity exceeds τ id = 0.55 \tau_{\text{id}}=0.55 are merged (when from different sources) or the lower-quality instance removed. The threshold τ id = 0.55 \tau_{\text{id}}=0.55 was chosen empirically: on a held-out set of manually verified same-identity and different-identity pairs, this value yielded a false-merge rate below 1 % 1\% while capturing over 90 % 90\% of cross-dataset duplicates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过四个标准来剔除可能影响下游评估的样本：(i) 检测到零个或多个面部的图像，这会引入标注歧义；(ii) 非 RGB 图像（例如灰度图像、红外图像），这些图像与依赖颜色的估计方法不兼容，尤其是 rPPG；(iii) 严重模糊的图像，这在 WebFace42M 中尤为普遍；(iv) 跨数据集的重复身份，通过计算预训练 ArcFace 模型 Deng et al. (2019) 和 InsightFace 库中每个身份的均值嵌入之间的成对余弦相似度来识别。 余弦相似度超过 τ id = 0.55 \tau_{\text{id}}=0.55 的身份对会被合并（如果来自不同来源），或者移除质量较低的样本。 阈值 τ id = 0.55 \tau_{\text{id}}=0.55 是通过经验选择的：在一个由人工验证的相同身份和不同身份对组成的保留测试集上，该值使错误合并率低于 1 % 1\%，同时捕捉到了超过 90 % 90\% 的跨数据集重复身份。

paragraphs.en: Surviving low-resolution samples are upsampled to 448 × 448 448{\times}448 or 512 × 512 512{\times}512 using blind face restoration, with the upsampling ratio capped at 4 × 4{\times} to preserve perceptual fidelity. We employ two complementary restoration methods: GFPGAN Wang et al. (2021) , which produces high-quality results for near-frontal faces, and CodeFormer Zhou et al. (2022) , which is more robust for faces with substantial pose variation where GFPGAN introduces visible artifacts such as eye-region asymmetry and texture flattening. Head pose is estimated from the detected 5 5 -point landmarks; samples with an estimated yaw magnitude above 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} are routed to CodeFormer, and the remainder to GFPGAN. Samples undetectable by MTCNN Zhang et al. (2016) after both restoration attempts are discarded.

paragraphs.en: We apply a no-reference perceptual quality filter based on NIQE Mittal et al. (2012) , discarding images with NIQE ≥ 5.0 \text{NIQE}\geq 5.0 . The threshold was chosen empirically using FFHQ Karras et al. (2019) as a naturalistic-face quality anchor: 95 % 95\% of FFHQ images fall below NIQE = 5.0 \text{NIQE}=5.0 , providing a principled cut-off that admits naturalistic, high-fidelity faces while rejecting restoration failures and residual low-quality samples from the source datasets. Filtering at this threshold removes approximately 58 % 58\% of the pool after Stage 2, disproportionately concentrated in the heavily-blurred WebFace42M subset.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用基于 NIQE Mittal 等人（2012）的无参考感知质量过滤器，丢弃 NIQE ≥ 5.0 \text{NIQE}\geq 5.0 的图像。该阈值是通过使用 FFHQ Karras 等人（2019）作为自然人脸质量的基准，以经验方式确定的：95% 95\% 的 FFHQ 图像的 NIQE 值低于 5.0 \text{NIQE}=5.0 ，这提供了一个有依据的截断点，既能保留自然、高保真的人脸，又能拒绝恢复失败以及源数据集中残留的低质量样本。在此阈值下过滤后，第 2 阶段之后约 58% 58\% 的图像池被移除，其中大部分集中在严重模糊的 WebFace42M 子集中。

paragraphs.en: The intended positive impact is a common, annotation-free yardstick that lets privacy-preserving face analysis be compared and improved reproducibly, and that exposes silent failures ( e.g. , destroyed physiological signals) before deployment in telehealth or surveillance contexts. Two negative uses are foreseeable. First, a benchmark that scores identity suppression against modern recognizers can be used to tune methods whose purpose is to evade lawful face recognition; we consider this risk modest because the recognizers we ensemble are public and the adversarial methods we evaluate already exist, and because the same measurements are what defenders need. Second, any face benchmark concentrates biometric data; the release design above (no pixels, no embeddings, gated research-only terms, removal on request) is our mitigation. HiFD is a machine-recognizer score and should not be read as a guarantee of anonymity against human observers or future recognizers.
paragraphs.zh: 预期的积极影响是一个通用且无需标注的衡量标准，它使得隐私保护的 лица 分析能够被可重复地比较和改进，并在部署于远程医疗或监控场景之前暴露潜在的无声失败（例如，被破坏的生理信号）。 可以预见两种负面用途。 首先，一个对身份抑制效果相对于现代识别器进行评分的基准，可能被用来调整旨在规避合法面部识别的方法；我们认为这种风险较低，因为我们组合使用的识别器是公开的，我们评估的对抗性方法已经存在，而且防守方也需要相同的测量指标。 其次，任何面部识别基准都会集中生物特征数据；上述发布设计（不泄露像素、不泄露嵌入向量、仅限研究用途的术语受控，并应要求移除）是我们采取的缓解措施。 HiFD 是一项针对机器识别器的评分，不应被解读为对抵御人类观察者或未来识别器而言具有匿名性的保证。

paragraphs.en: Both tasks produce softmax outputs 𝐩 ∈ Δ K − 1 \mathbf{p}\in\Delta^{K-1} over K K classes ( K = 7 K=7 for FairFace ethnicity, K = 7 K=7 for POSTER macro-expression on RAF-DB). paragraphs.en: Three failure modes of the non-harmonic schemes emerge from Tab. 6 . (i) Arithmetic mean is uninformative for unbalanced profiles. Adv-Makeup ( P ¯ = 0.012 \bar{P}\!=\!0.012 ) achieves the highest 𝒜 = 0.673 \mathcal{A}=0.673 across all twelve methods, and DeID-rPPG ( P ¯ = 0.013 \bar{P}\!=\!0.013 ) ranks fourth at 𝒜 = 0.630 \mathcal{A}=0.630 , both near-zero-privacy methods are placed in the top four despite offering essentially no identity suppression. The valid leader TIP-IM is demoted to rank 3 3 ( 𝒜 = 0.650 \mathcal{A}=0.650 ), trailing Adv-Makeup by 0.023 0.023 . (ii) Geometric mean ranks the bottom correctly but scores it too leniently. Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG, both with near-zero privacy ( P ¯ ≤ 0.013 \bar{P}\!\leq\!0.013 ), correctly fall to ranks 11 11 and 12 12 under 𝒢 \mathcal{G} , yet their scores ( 𝒢 = 0.350 \mathcal{G}\!=\!0.350 and 0.332 0.332 ) land within 0.05 0.05 of mid-pack AMT-GAN ( 𝒢 = 0.372 \mathcal{G}\!=\!0.372 ), whose privacy is an order of magnitude higher ( P ¯ = 0.156 \bar{P}\!=\!0.156 ). Under ℋ \mathcal{H} , the same two methods score 4 4 to 5 5 times lower than AMT-GAN ( ℋ = 0.282 \mathcal{H}\!=\!0.282 ), and the leader-to-loser gap widens from 𝒢 \mathcal{G} ’s 0.296 0.296 to 0.551 0.551 . Vetoing requires that a near-zero component drive the composite toward zero, not merely to the bottom of a narrow range, so 𝒢 \mathcal{G} satisfies vetoing in rank but not in score. (iii) Harmonic mean correctly resolves both pathologies. Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG drop to ranks 12 12 and 11 11 at ℋ ∈ { 0.056 , 0.061 } \mathcal{H}\in\{0.056,0.061\} , an order of magnitude below the leader TIP-IM ( ℋ = 0.607 \mathcal{H}=0.607 ); the gap is now 0.551 0.551 . The rank order between TIP-IM (rank 1) and Adv-Makeup (rank 12) under ℋ \mathcal{H} is exactly inverted relative to 𝒜 \mathcal{A} (where Adv-Makeup is rank 1 and TIP-IM rank 3): the harmonic mean does not merely widen an existing gap, it reverses an incorrect ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 表6揭示了非谐波方案存在的三种失效模式。 （i）对于不平衡的分布，算术平均值无法提供有效信息。 Adv-Makeup（P¯ = 0.012 \bar{P}\!=\!0.012）在全部十二种方法中取得了最高的𝒜 = 0.673 \mathcal{A}=0.673，而DeID-rPPG（P¯ = 0.013 \bar{P}\!=\!0.013）排名第四，得分为𝒜 = 0.630 \mathcal{A}=0.630；尽管这两种接近零隐私的方法几乎不提供身份抑制能力，但它们仍进入了前四名。 有效的领先方法TIP-IM被降至第3名（𝒜 = 0.650 \mathcal{A}=0.650），比Adv-Makeup低0.023。 （ii）几何平均值正确识别了排名靠后的方法，但评分过于宽松。 Adv-Makeup和DeID-rPPG都具有接近零的隐私性（P¯ ≤ 0.013 \bar{P}\!\leq\!0.013），在𝒢 \mathcal{G}指标下正确降至第11名和第12名，但它们的得分（𝒢 = 0.350 \mathcal{G}\!=\!0.350和0.332）与中位水平的AMT-GAN（𝒢 = 0.372 \mathcal{G}\!=\!0.372）的差距不足0.05，而AMT-GAN的隐私性高出一个数量级（P¯ = 0.156 \bar{P}\!=\!0.156）。 在ℋ \mathcal{H}指标下，这两种方法的得分比AMT-GAN低4到5倍（ℋ = 0.282 \mathcal{H}\!=\!0.282），领先者与落后者之间的差距从𝒢 \mathcal{G}下的0.296扩大到0.551。 否决机制要求接近零的组件将综合得分推向零，而不仅仅是推向一个狭窄区间的底部，因此𝒢 \mathcal{G}在排名上满足否决机制，但在得分上并不满足。 （iii）调和平均值正确解决了这两种异常问题。 当ℋ ∈ { 0.056 , 0.061 }时，Adv-Makeup和DeID-rPPG分别降至第12名和第11名，比领先方法TIP-IM（ℋ = 0.607 \mathcal{H}=0.607）低一个数量级；此时两者之间的差距为0.551。 在ℋ \mathcal{H}指标下，TIP-IM（第1名）和Adv-Makeup（第12名）的排名顺序与𝒜 \mathcal{A}指标下的顺序完全相反（在𝒜指标中，Adv-Makeup排名第1，TIP-IM排名第3）：调和平均值不仅扩大了原有的差距，还逆转了错误的排名。

paragraphs.en: Property (iii) vetoing from § 3.2 requires that any near-zero component drives the composite toward zero (exactly what is observed for ℋ \mathcal{H} on Adv-Makeup and DeID-rPPG). This property is what makes HiFD a valid privacy-utility trade-off score: an FDeID method that fails on identity suppression should not be ranked highly regardless of its utility profile, because such a method does not de-identify in the first place. Neither 𝒜 \mathcal{A} (which inverts the correct ranking by placing Adv-Makeup at rank 1 1 ) nor 𝒢 \mathcal{G} (which preserves the ranking but compresses near-zero-privacy methods into the same neighborhood as methods with real identity suppression) satisfies this requirement, justifying the weighted harmonic mean as the only sound choice for HiFD .
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.2 节中否决机制的第三条性质要求，任何接近零的分量都会使合成值趋向于零（这正是 ℋ \mathcal{H} 在 Adv-Makeup 和 DeID-rPPG 上观察到的情况）。 正是这一性质使得 HiFD 成为一个有效的隐私-效用权衡评分：一个在身份抑制方面失败的方法，无论其效用表现如何，都不应获得高排名，因为这类方法根本未能实现去标识化。 既不是 𝒜 \mathcal{A}（它通过将 Adv-Makeup 排在第 1 位而颠倒了正确的排名），也不是 𝒢 \mathcal{G}（它保留了排名，但将接近零隐私的方法压缩到了与真正具备身份抑制方法相同的区间内）满足这一要求，因此加权调和平均是 HiFD 唯一合理的选择。

paragraphs.en: This section collects the experiments that establish how far HiFD can be trusted: the validation of the consistency paradigm behind § 4.3 against ground truth, the operational calibration of P ¯ \bar{P} , statistical uncertainty, estimator substitution, weight sensitivity, and the quality axis.
paragraphs.zh: 本节汇集了各项实验，旨在确定 HiFD 的可靠性程度：包括对 § 4.3 中一致性范式的验证（通过与真实数据对比）、P ¯ \bar{P} 的操作校准、统计不确定性、估计量替换、权重敏感性以及质量轴的分析。

paragraphs.en: The consistency formulation replaces per-image labels with estimator consistency. This section tests, on the two attribute families for which ground truth is obtainable, whether consistency tracks true utility preservation; § 4.3 summarizes the results.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性公式将每张图像的标签替换为估计器一致性。 本节在能够获得真实值的两个属性族上检验，一致性是否能够追踪真实的效用保留；§ 4.3 总结了结果。

paragraphs.en: We de-identified the entire RAF-DB test split ( 3,068 3{,}068 images with ground-truth seven-class expression labels; POSTER’s training distribution, which is what makes labels available) with all twelve methods, and for every (method, image) pair recorded both the consistency score s macro-exp ​ ( 𝐱 , 𝐱 ^ ) s_{\text{macro-exp}}(\mathbf{x},\hat{\mathbf{x}}) and whether the same estimator still predicts the correct label on 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} . POSTER reaches 77.8 % 77.8\% accuracy on the originals. Tab. 7 reports per-method results; pooled over 28,614 28{,}614 pairs, the consistency score predicts label survival with AUC 0.981 0.981 , and among the 20,096 20{,}096 pairs with consistency above 0.8 0.8 only 1.06 % 1.06\% have a flipped true label. Across methods, mean consistency correlates with ground-truth accuracy retention at Spearman 0.944 0.944 and Pearson 0.992 0.992 ; the leading group (Adv-Makeup, DeID-rPPG, AMT-GAN) and the worst method (CIAGAN) coincide under both. The out-of-distribution complement is the POSTER/AffectNet substitution of Appendix C.4 , which agrees with the RAF-DB-trained estimator at Spearman 0.979 0.979 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用全部十二种方法对 RAF-DB 测试集的全部数据（3,068 张带有七类表情真实标签的图像；POSTER 的训练分布正是其提供标签的原因）进行了去标识化处理，并为每一对（方法、图像）记录了宏观一致性得分 s_{\text{macro-exp}}(\mathbf{x},\hat{\mathbf{x}})，以及同一估计器在 \hat{\mathbf{x}} 上是否仍能预测出正确标签。 POSTER 在原始数据上的准确率达到 77.8%。 表 7 报告了每种方法的结果；在 28,614 对数据的汇总结果中，一致性得分预测标签保留情况的 AUC 为 0.981，而在一致性高于 0.8 的 20,096 对数据中，仅有 1.06% 的真实标签发生翻转。 在所有方法中，平均一致性与真实标签准确率的保留程度存在斯皮尔曼相关系数 0.944、皮尔逊相关系数 0.992 的相关性；在两种相关性指标下，表现最佳的组别（Adv-Makeup、DeID-rPPG、AMT-GAN）与表现最差的方法（CIAGAN）均保持一致。 分布外补充实验是附录 C.4 中的 POSTER/AffectNet 替换实验，其与 RAF-DB 训练的估计器之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.979。

paragraphs.en: MMPD and PURE ship contact-sensor pulse waveforms, so the true heart rate of every clip is known. For each method we compute the mean absolute HR error of the rPPG ensemble on the de-identified clips minus that on the originals ( Δ \Delta MAE, in bpm); a method that preserves the pulse leaves Δ \Delta MAE near zero. Ranking methods by − Δ -\Delta MAE agrees with the consistency-based U 3 U_{3} at Spearman 0.944 0.944 on MMPD ( 0.993 0.993 on PURE) with the same top three (Adv-Makeup, DeID-rPPG, Chameleon) and bottom three (AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, WeakenDiff) on both datasets (per-method values in Tab. 13 ). Among clips whose consistency score exceeds 0.8 0.8 , none has a de-identification-induced HR error above 10 10 bpm on either dataset ( 21,951 21{,}951 chunks on MMPD, 9,839 9{,}839 on PURE), so a high U 3 U_{3} never hides a destroyed pulse. In absolute terms the estimators, used without retraining, are weak on MMPD ( 34.3 34.3 bpm MAE on the originals against 21.9 21.9 bpm on PURE); the consistency score measures the change induced by de-identification, which is what the contact sensor validates, not absolute accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: MMPD 和 PURE 都包含接触传感器的脉搏波形，因此每个片段中真实的心率都是已知的。 对于每种方法，我们计算去标识化片段上 rPPG 集合的平均绝对心率误差与原始片段上的误差之差（Δ \Delta MAE，单位：次/分钟）；能够保留脉搏的方法会使 Δ \Delta MAE 接近于零。 根据 − Δ -\Delta MAE 对方法排序的结果与基于一致性的 U 3 U_{3} 高度吻合：在 MMPD 数据集上 Spearman 相关系数为 0.944，在 PURE 数据集上为 0.993；两种方法的前三名（Adv-Makeup、DeID-rPPG、Chameleon）和后三名（AMT-GAN、CIAGAN、WeakenDiff）完全一致（各方法的具体数值见第 13 表）。 在一致性得分超过 0.8 的片段中，无论在哪一个数据集上，都没有出现因去标识化导致的心率误差超过 10 次/分钟的情况（MMPD 数据集上有 21,951 个片段，PURE 数据集上有 9,839 个片段），因此较高的 U 3 U_{3} 绝不会掩盖脉搏被破坏的事实。 从绝对值来看，未经重新训练的估计器在 MMPD 上的表现较弱（原始片段上的 MAE 为 34.3 次/分钟，而 PURE 上仅为 21.9 次/分钟）；一致性得分衡量的是去标识化所引发的变化，而这正是接触传感器所验证的内容，而非绝对准确性。

paragraphs.en: P ¯ \bar{P} is a rescaled embedding dissimilarity. To give it an operational reading we fit verification thresholds for each recognizer and for the ensemble score on 3 3 M different-identity impostor pairs drawn from UtilFace originals, at false-accept rates of 10 − 2 10^{-2} , 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and 10 − 4 10^{-4} (ensemble cosine thresholds 0.172 0.172 , 0.247 0.247 , and 0.316 0.316 ; per-recognizer thresholds 0.165 0.165 to 0.355 0.355 ). De-identification success is the fraction of UtilFace images whose de-identified version is not verified as its own original at that threshold. Tab. 8 reports the ensemble success rates at all three FARs; per-recognizer rates follow the same pattern, with AdaFace the hardest recognizer to escape ( e.g. , TIP-IM 0.759 0.759 / 0.868 0.868 / 0.933 0.933 on AdaFace against 0.930 0.930 / 0.970 0.970 / 0.987 0.987 on ArcFace at the three FARs). In practitioner units, P ¯ ≈ 0.5 \bar{P}\!\approx\!0.5 maps to 93 93 to 97 % 97\% de-identification at FAR ≤ 10 − 3 \leq 10^{-3} , the middle band ( P ¯ \bar{P} from 0.11 0.11 to 0.24 0.24 ) to 27 % 27\% down to under 1 % 1\% , and P ¯ ≈ 0.01 \bar{P}\!\approx\!0.01 to 0 % 0\% ; the residual (MI-FGSM and PGD reach 8 % 8\% at a P ¯ \bar{P} near AMT-GAN’s) is what a continuous margin meeting a thresholded decision produces. Spearman correlation between P ¯ \bar{P} and success is 0.783 0.783 , 0.769 0.769 , and 0.804 0.804 at the three thresholds; the same three methods (TI-DIM, TIP-IM, CIAGAN) lead under P ¯ \bar{P} and under success, their internal order differing at 10 − 3 10^{-3} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The threat model is a machine recognizer: Appendix E shows that human same-person judgments reproduce this ranking within a paradigm but not across paradigms, because adversarial perturbations are engineered against recognizers and leave the face plainly recognizable to a person.
paragraphs.zh: P ¯ \bar{P} 是一个经过重新缩放的嵌入不相似性指标。 为了使其具有可操作性，我们对每个识别器以及集成得分在从 UtilFace 原始数据中抽取的 330 万对身份不同的冒用者样本上拟合了验证阈值，假接受率分别为 10^{-2}、10^{-3} 和 10^{-4}（集成余弦阈值分别为 0.172、0.247 和 0.316；每个识别器的阈值范围从 0.165 到 0.355）。 去标识成功是指 UtilFace 图像中，其去标识版本在该阈值下未被验证为原始图像自身的比例。 表 8 报告了所有三种 FAR 下的集成成功率；各识别器的成功率也遵循相同模式，其中 AdaFace 是最难逃脱的识别器（例如，在三种 FAR 下，AdaFace 上的 TIP-IM 成功率为 0.759 / 0.868 / 0.933，而 ArcFace 上为 0.930 / 0.970 / 0.987）。 用实际应用的单位表示，当 P ¯ ≈ 0.5 时，在 FAR ≤ 10^{-3} 的情况下，去标识成功率对应于 93% 到 97%；中间区间（P ¯ 从 0.11 到 0.24）对应 27% 到不足 1%；而当 P ¯ ≈ 0.01 时，成功率为 0%。剩余部分（MI-FGSM 和 PGD 在 P ¯ 接近 AMT-GAN 水平时达到 8%）是连续余差满足阈值化决策所产生的结果。 在三种阈值下，P ¯ 与成功率之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数分别为 0.783、0.769 和 0.804；相同的三种方法（TI-DIM、TIP-IM、CIAGAN）在 P ¯ 和成功率上均呈现相同顺序，但在 10^{-3} 和 10^{-4} 时内部排序有所不同。 威胁模型是一个机器识别器：附录 E 表明，人类对同一人物的判断在同一范式内能重现这种排名，但不同范式之间则不然，因为对抗性扰动是针对识别器设计的，并不会使人脸在人类看来变得不可辨认。

paragraphs.en: Image-level sub-scores on UtilFace are resampled at the identity level ( 2,062 2{,}062 identity blocks over the 2,069 2{,}069 curated identities, recovered as contiguous key runs), micro-expression at the subject level on DFME ( 42 42 subjects), and rPPG at the subject level on PURE ( 10 10 subjects) and MMPD ( 33 33 subjects). Each of B = 2,000 B=2{,}000 resamples draws blocks with replacement, recomputes every component mean, and re-aggregates the composite; we report percentile 95% intervals. Intervals therefore capture sampling variability over identities and subjects, not estimator or seed variability.
paragraphs.zh: UtilFace 的图像级子分数在身份层面进行重采样（在 2,069 个精选身份中，有 2,062 个身份块被恢复为连续的关键运行），DFME 的微观表情在受试者层面进行重采样（42 名受试者），以及 PURE 和 MMPD 的 rPPG 在受试者层面进行重采样（分别涉及 10 名和 33 名受试者）。 每次从 B = 2,000 个重采样中抽取块时均采用放回抽样，重新计算每个分量的均值，并重新聚合组合结果；我们报告第 95 百分位数的置信区间。 因此，这些区间反映了身份和受试者之间的采样变异性，而非估计量或随机种子带来的变异性。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 9 lists the intervals. (i) TIP-IM is top-1 in 100 % 100\% of the 2,000 2{,}000 resamples; its margin over the runner-up is 0.097 0.097 with 95% CI [ 0.086 , 0.108 ] [0.086,0.108] . (ii) The intervals of TI-DIM ( [ 0.490 , 0.519 ] [0.490,0.519] ) and Chameleon ( [ 0.503 , 0.516 ] [0.503,0.516] ) overlap and their order varies across resamples, so we report ranks 2 and 3 as a tie throughout the paper. (iii) The image axes are estimated with half-widths below 0.006 0.006 , whereas the video axes are wider: the mean micro-expression interval width is 0.047 0.047 against 0.0027 0.0027 for gaze (a ratio of 17.6 17.6 ), and the PURE U 3 U_{3} intervals are the widest in the table because ten subjects is few. This asymmetry is the reason L2 and L3 conclusions carry less evidential weight than L1. It does not put the L2 conclusions in doubt, since the intervals remain far apart for every comparison that matters ( e.g. , CIAGAN U 2 = 0.658 U_{2}=0.658 [ 0.644 , 0.671 ] [0.644,0.671] against Adv-Makeup 0.936 0.936 [ 0.927 , 0.944 ] [0.927,0.944] ). (iv) The small video corpora refine but do not drive the composite: scoring on the image axes alone ( P ¯ \bar{P} , Q Q , U 1 U_{1} , gaze, every small- N N video component removed) agrees with the full ranking at Spearman 0.888 0.888 with the same top three, removing Q Q leaves Spearman 0.979 0.979 , and the held-out MMPD replication (Appendix D.3 ) tightens the U 3 U_{3} intervals by an order of magnitude while reproducing the PURE ordering. On the concern that the harmonic mean amplifies a noisy weak component: vetoing is intentional (a method that fails an axis should not rank highly), it acts on the mean of each axis rather than on a single sample, and the intervals above make the residual uncertainty explicit.

paragraphs.en: The consistency formulation transfers the annotation dependency to an estimator dependency. We therefore test, over every scored image in UtilFace , whether replacing an L1 estimator by an independently trained public checkpoint changes the ranking. The alternatives (listed with their architectures and training corpora in Tab. 15 ) are: for ethnicity, a ViT with its own five -class label space, a stricter test than a same-taxonomy swap; for macro-expression, POSTER trained on AffectNet instead of RAF-DB, and an independently trained FER ViT; for age, a ViT age classifier instead of MiVOLO. We ran both direct substitution (one estimator swapped) and multi-model averaging.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性公式将标注依赖转移到了估计器依赖上。 因此，我们对 UtilFace 中每张评分过的图像进行测试，以判断用独立训练的公开检查点替换 L1 估计器是否会改变排名。 替代方案（其架构和训练语料列于表 15）包括：对于种族，使用一个拥有自身五类标签空间的 ViT，这比相同分类体系下的替换测试更为严格；对于宏表情，使用在 AffectNet 而非 RAF-DB 上训练的 POSTER，以及一个独立训练的 FER ViT；对于年龄，使用一个 ViT 年龄分类器来替代 MiVOLO。 我们同时运行了直接替换（替换一个估计器）和多模型平均两种方法。

Fig. 8 re-aggregates the component scores of Tab. 3 while one weight sweeps continuously from 0.2 0.2 to 0.6 0.6 and the remaining weight is split equally over the other four axes; Tab. 11 tabulates the four methods that are ever in the top three. TIP-IM is rank 1 at every w P w_{P} ; the only top-three change is CIAGAN, whose P ¯ = 0.45 \bar{P}=0.45 is the highest among GAN methods, rising from rank 6 to rank 3 as privacy is weighted more heavily. Under w 3 w_{3} , TIP-IM stays first until w 3 = 0.6 w_{3}=0.6 , where Chameleon ( U 3 = 0.80 U_{3}=0.80 , the highest among methods with P ¯ > 0.2 \bar{P}>0.2 ) edges ahead by 0.006 0.006 . paragraphs.en: Half of Q Q is LPIPS similarity to the original. Since successful identity replacement necessarily changes appearance, LPIPS could in principle conflate “changed the face” with “degraded the face”. We tested this with two measures that never see the original, BRISQUE Mittal et al. (2011) and TOPIQ face-IQA Chen et al. (2024) , on a paired 12,000 12{,}000 -image subset per method, and rebuilt a reference-free quality term Q nr Q_{\text{nr}} as the mean of the two normalized scores. Tab. 12 reports the results. Three observations. (i) LPIPS is not the mechanism penalizing replacement methods: dropping it moves the replacement family down on average (mean rank shift − 0.5 -0.5 ) and the perturbation family up ( + 0.5 +0.5 ), and CIAGAN falls from rank 6 6 to 9 9 rather than rising, because its quality deficit is visible without any reference (BRISQUE 80.9 80.9 and TOPIQ 0.250 0.250 against 38.4 38.4 and 0.752 0.752 for the originals, and the highest face-detection failure rate of any method, 0.7 % 0.7\% ). Genuinely clean appearance-changing methods score near the originals (Adv-Makeup 39.0 39.0 , AMT-GAN 39.4 39.4 ). (ii) The published and reference-free Q Q rank methods almost independently (Spearman 0.126 0.126 ): the two capture different things, fidelity to the source versus freedom from artifacts, which is why we report the sub-scores separately. (iii) The composite is insensitive to the choice: substituting Q nr Q_{\text{nr}} leaves Spearman 0.951 0.951 with the same top three, and removing Q Q altogether leaves 0.979 0.979 . The human study (Appendix E ) adds that LPIPS has no detectable rank association with human naturalness, so Q Q should be described as an artifact and fidelity term rather than a naturalness term.
paragraphs.zh: Q Q 的一半是相对于原始图像的 LPIPS 相似度。由于成功的身份替换必然改变外观，LPIPS 原则上可能会将“改变了面部”与“破坏了面部质量”混为一谈。我们使用两种从未见过原始图像的方法——BRISQUE（Mittal 等人，2011）和 TOPIQ face-IQA（Chen 等人，2024）——对此进行了测试，每种方法都基于一个包含 12,000 张图像的配对子集，并构建了一个无参考的质量指标 Q nr（Q_{\text{nr}}），作为两个归一化分数的平均值。表 12 报告了结果。有三项观察结果：（i）LPIPS 并非惩罚替换方法的机制：移除 LPIPS 后，替换方法族的平均排名下降（平均排名变化为 -0.5），而扰动方法族的排名则上升（+0.5）。CIAGAN 的排名从第 6 位降至第 9 位，而非上升，因为其质量缺陷无需任何参考图像即可显现（BRISQUE 得分为 80.9，TOPIQ 得分为 0.250，而原始图像的对应分数分别为 38.4 和 0.752；此外，CIAGAN 的面部检测失败率在所有方法中最高，为 0.7%）。真正能够干净地改变外观的方法得分接近原始图像（Adv-Makeup 得分为 39.0，AMT-GAN 得分为 39.4）。（ii）已发表的 Q Q 与无参考的 Q Q 对方法的排名几乎相互独立（Spearman 相关系数为 0.126）：这两个指标衡量的是不同的方面——对源图像的保真度与无伪影程度，因此我们分别报告了子分数。（iii）该组合指标对具体选择并不敏感：用 Q nr（Q_{\text{nr}}）替代 Q Q 后，Spearman 相关系数仍为 0.951，且前三名排名不变；完全移除 Q Q 后，相关系数为 0.979。人类研究（附录 E）补充指出，LPIPS 与人类感知到的自然度之间没有可检测的排名关联，因此 Q Q 应被描述为一个伪影和保真度指标，而非自然度指标。

paragraphs.en: We present qualitative comparisons on two representative UtilFace samples chosen to span pose and lighting variation: Fig. 9 shows a near-frontal female subject under uniform illumination, and Fig. 10 shows a three-quarter-view male subject under lateral lighting. The 12-method grids are organized identically (rows by paradigm, columns by method) to enable cross-method visual comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对两个具有代表性的 UtilFace 样本进行了定性比较，这两个样本分别涵盖了姿态和光照的变化：图 9 展示了一名在均匀光照下的近乎正面的女性受试者，而图 10 则展示了一名在侧向光照下的四分之三视角的男性受试者。 这 12 种方法的网格以相同的方式排列（按范式分行，按方法分列），以便进行跨方法的视觉比较。
