paragraphs.en: We extend the demographic decomposition of Fig. 6 to the two non-balanced profiles defined in § 3.2 : the Privacy-First profile (Fig. 11 ), which doubles the privacy weight, and the Clinical profile (Fig. 12 ), which emphasizes physiological L3 utility.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将图 6 的人口统计学分解方法扩展到第 3.2 节中定义的两个非平衡配置：隐私优先配置（图 11），它将隐私权重加倍；以及临床配置（图 12），它强调生理 L3 效用。

paragraphs.en: Under Privacy-First , the aggregate male-female gap widens slightly to 0.018 0.018 (female 0.287 0.287 , male 0.269 0.269 ) and the ethnicity spread widens to 0.021 0.021 (East Asian highest at 0.292 0.292 , Black lowest at 0.271 0.271 ). Per-method, Chameleon shows the widest gender gap ( 0.048 0.048 ) and the widest ethnicity range ( 0.075 0.075 , peaking on Southeast Asian), while CIAGAN, Adv-Makeup, and DeID-rPPG retain ranges below 0.010 0.010 . Under Clinical , the aggregate gaps shrink: 0.008 0.008 for gender and 0.013 0.013 for ethnicity, with PGD the widest by ethnicity ( 0.059 0.059 , East Asian peak) and Chameleon the widest by gender ( 0.032 0.032 ). Across both profiles, the qualitative structure observed on the Balanced profile is preserved: the East-Asian-peak / Black-trough ordering survives the reweighting on the aggregate. The per-method peak ethnicity is method-specific rather than profile-specific (PGD and MI-FGSM peak on East Asian, Chameleon on Southeast Asian, DiffAM on Black) and matches the Balanced ranking; and the methods with the smallest disparities under the Balanced HiFD (TIP-IM, TI-DIM, CIAGAN, Adv-Makeup; ethnicity range ≤ 0.020 \leq 0.020 under every profile) remain so. The top-ranked method TIP-IM continues to lead under both profiles ( HiFD = 0.560 \textbf{HiFD}\!=\!0.560 Privacy-First, 0.611 0.611 Clinical) with gender gap ≤ 0.021 \leq 0.021 and ethnicity range ≤ 0.019 \leq 0.019 , so its leadership is not a profile-specific artifact. Profile reweighting changes which component is amplified, not which subgroup is favored.

paragraphs.en: PURE has ten subjects, so we replicate the L3 evaluation on a larger dataset. We de-identified the full MMPD dataset Tang et al. (2023) ( 33 33 subjects, 655 655 trials, 392,832 392{,}832 frames after intersecting the keys common to all methods; frame-identical across conditions) with all twelve methods and re-ran the three rPPG estimators with no retraining. We deliberately did not use UBFC-rPPG, on which PhysNet, EfficientPhys, and FactorizePhys are trained, to avoid a train/test leak. MMPD is stratified by four illumination conditions (LED-low, LED-high, incandescent, natural) and five motion conditions (stationary, stationary after exercise, rotation, talking, walking), which lets us check that the family-level separation is not an artifact of one recording condition.
paragraphs.zh: PURE 包含十个受试者，因此我们在一个更大的数据集上重复了 L3 评估。我们对完整的 MMPD 数据集（Tang et al., 2023）进行了去标识处理（该数据集包含 33 个受试者、655 次试验，以及在所有方法共有的键进行交集后得到的 392,832 帧；各条件下的帧完全相同），并使用全部十二种方法进行处理，然后在不重新训练的情况下再次运行了三种 rPPG 估计器。我们刻意没有使用 UBFC-rPPG（PhysNet、EfficientPhys 和 FactorizePhys 均基于该数据集进行训练），以避免训练集与测试集之间的信息泄露。MMPD 数据集按四种照明条件（低亮度 LED、高亮度 LED、白炽灯、自然光）和五种运动条件（静止、运动后静止、旋转、说话、行走）进行分层，这使我们能够验证家族级别的分离并非由某种特定的记录条件所导致的人为现象。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 13 reports the results. The PURE ordering replicates at Spearman 0.986 0.986 with the same top three (Adv-Makeup, DeID-rPPG, Chameleon) and bottom three (AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, WeakenDiff), and the MMPD intervals (subject-level bootstrap over 33 33 subjects) are five to six times tighter than the PURE intervals of Tab. 9 , so U 3 U_{3} is no longer the small-sample component of the composite. Finding 2 replicates at the family level: the five adversarial methods average U 3 = 0.566 U_{3}=0.566 on MMPD ( 0.577 0.577 on PURE), the seven generative methods 0.424 0.424 ( 0.472 0.472 ), and the five generative methods that resynthesize the face region (AMT-GAN, CIAGAN, G 2 Face, WeakenDiff, DiffAM) only 0.272 0.272 ( 0.293 0.293 ); the two GAN methods that leave the skin largely untouched, Adv-Makeup (eye-region makeup) and DeID-rPPG (trained to preserve the pulse), are the exceptions already noted. The separation is not an artifact of one condition: Adv-Makeup holds U 3 ∈ [ 0.863 , 0.920 ] U_{3}\in[0.863,0.920] across every illumination and motion condition and CIAGAN stays within [ 0.128 , 0.224 ] [0.128,0.224] throughout. Two methods move noticeably between datasets (DeID-rPPG 0.907 → 0.729 0.907\to 0.729 , Chameleon 0.799 → 0.709 0.799\to 0.709 ), consistent with MMPD’s harder motion and lighting, without changing their ranks. The contact-sensor columns give the same ranking from ground truth rather than consistency.

paragraphs.en: HiFD is estimator-based. The study reported here asks whether its judgments agree with human perception on the three axes where a mismatch would matter most: (H1) does human naturalness track the reference-free quality terms rather than LPIPS; (H2) does human-judged attribute preservation track U 1 U_{1} , with the concrete counter-hypothesis that CIAGAN preserves demographics to a human despite its low U 1 U_{1} ; (H3) does the privacy score track human identity matching. It is not a validation of HiFD against human perception in general, and we report its limits with its results.
paragraphs.zh: HiFD 基于估计器。 本研究探讨了其判断是否与人类在三个最关键的轴向上的感知一致，这些轴向上出现不匹配将产生重大影响：(H1) 人类的自然性是否更贴近无参考的质量指标而非 LPIPS；(H2) 人类判断的属性保留程度是否与 U 1 U_{1} 一致，具体反假设为 CIAGAN 尽管 U 1 U_{1} 较低，但仍能保留符合人类感知的人口统计学特征；(H3) 隐私分数是否与人类对身份匹配的判断一致。 这并非对 HiFD 与人类普遍感知之间一致性的验证，我们也在结果中报告了其局限性。

paragraphs.en: Within-subject, two parts, the unpaired part always first so that seeing an original cannot anchor the naturalness judgments. Part 1 (unpaired). One face at a time, no original shown, condition not disclosed; two independent 5-point items: naturalness (“Could this be a real, unedited photograph?”, from Definitely edited to Definitely a real photo ) and artifacts (“How visible are visual defects?”, from None visible to Severe ). Unmodified originals are included as unlabeled stimuli. Part 2 (paired). Original and de-identified image side by side with random left/right order; the rater ticks which of four attributes still match (age within about ten years, gender, ethnicity, facial expression) as independent checkboxes, then judges identity (same person / different people / unsure). Asking per attribute is deliberate: U 1 U_{1} is an average of per-attribute consistency scores, so only a per-attribute human measurement is commensurable with it.
paragraphs.zh: 在受试者内部实验中，分为两个部分，未配对部分始终先呈现，以确保看到原始图像不会成为自然性判断的参照。第 1 部分（未配对）。 每次仅展示一张人脸，不显示原始图像，且实验条件不予透露；包含两个独立的 5 分制项目：自然性（“这是否可能是一张真实、未经编辑的照片？”，评分范围从“明显经过编辑”到“肯定是真实照片”）和人工痕迹（“视觉缺陷有多明显？”，评分范围从“完全不可见”到“非常严重”）。 未修改的原始图像被作为无标签刺激材料包含在内。第 2 部分（配对）。 原始图像与去标识化图像并排展示，左右顺序随机；评估者通过独立的复选框勾选四个属性中哪些仍然匹配（年龄相差约十年以内、性别、种族、面部表情），然后判断身份是否为同一人、不同人或不确定。 按属性分别提问是有意为之：U 1 U_{1} 是各属性一致性分数的平均值，因此只有按属性进行的人类测量才与之具有可比性。

paragraphs.en: Three checks were fixed before collection: mean naturalness on originals at or above 3.0 3.0 ; the corrupted image rated at most 2.0 2.0 ; identical pairs judged “same person”. A rater failing two or more checks is excluded; trials answered faster than 800 800 ms are dropped. 24 24 raters were collected; the rule excluded 2 2 , leaving 22 22 against a target of 30 30 . Check 1 turned out to be mis-specified against a restored-image benchmark (it fires for 10 10 of 24 24 raters because the originals themselves are rated only 3.32 / 5 3.32/5 ; see below) and is retained only because it was pre-registered; every result below is stable under all four exclusion rules we tested, including one that keeps only 9 9 raters.
paragraphs.zh: 在收集前修正了三项检查：原始图像的平均自然度为 3.0 或更高（3.0）；受损图像的评分最高为 2.0（2.0）；完全相同的图像对被判定为“同一人”。 两项或以上检查未通过的评价员将被排除；答题时间快于 800 毫秒（800 ms）的试验将被舍弃。共收集了 24 名评价员；该规则排除了 2 人，最终留下 22 人，而原定目标为 30 人。 检查 1 在与修复图像的基准对比中被发现定义不当（由于原始图像本身的评分仅为 3.32/5，因此有 24 名评价员中的 10 人触发了该检查；见下文），仅因其已在事前注册而保留；以下所有结果在我们测试的四种排除规则下均保持稳定，其中一种规则仅保留 9 名评价员。

paragraphs.en: Participants were consenting adults ( ≥ 18 \geq 18 ) recruited as a convenience sample. Participation was voluntary. No name, e-mail address, IP address, or other identifying information was recorded; responses stayed in the rater’s browser until the rater chose to download and return a results file, with no server, cookies, or tracking, and withdrawal was possible at any point by closing the page. Raters were told that the faces are of real people from public research datasets and were asked not to save or share them. The consent screen and the two instruction screens are reproduced verbatim below.

paragraphs.en: Face image perception study. About 15 minutes. No personal data is collected. What you will do. You will look at photographs of faces and answer short questions about them. Some images are unmodified photographs; others have been altered by automatic privacy-protection software. Your job is to report what you see. There are no right or wrong answers on the rating questions. About the images. The faces are of real people, taken from public research datasets that are already used for scientific work under their stated licences. Please do not save, copy or share the images. Your data. No name, email, IP address or any identifying information is recorded. Responses stay in your browser until you download a results file at the end and return it to the researcher. No cookies and no tracking of any kind. You may stop at any time by closing this page; nothing is sent unless you choose to download and return the file. Responses are used only in aggregate, to evaluate an image-quality metric. Before you start. Use a laptop or desktop if you can, on a screen you can see clearly. Work somewhere without glare, at your normal viewing distance. If you use glasses or contacts for screen work, please wear them. [ ] I am at least 18 years old, I have read the above, and I agree to take part.

paragraphs.en: Part 1 of 2: single images. You will see one face at a time. For each one, answer two separate questions. Question 1. Is it a real photo? Could this be an ordinary, unedited photograph of a person? Judge the image as a whole. Do not try to guess whether software was used, just report how real it looks to you. Question 2. Are there visible defects? Blurring, smearing, warped features, visible seams or edges, odd colour patches, repeated texture. Report only what you can actually see. These two questions are independent. An image can look like a real photograph and still have a small defect somewhere, and a picture can be defect-free yet still look artificial. Please answer each on its own. You can click the options or press keys 1 to 5. Answer at a comfortable pace and trust your first impression; there is no time limit but you should not deliberate for long.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 部分（共 2 部分）：单张图片。 你每次只会看到一张脸。 针对每张图片，请回答两个独立的问题。问题 1：这是一张真实的照片吗？ 这会不会是一张普通、未经编辑的人像照片？ 从整体上判断这张图片。 不要试图猜测是否使用了软件，只需说明它在你看来有多真实。问题 2： 是否存在可见的缺陷？ 例如模糊、涂抹、特征扭曲、可见的接缝或边缘、异常的颜色斑块、重复的纹理。 只报告你实际能看到的内容。 这两个问题是独立的。 一张图片可能看起来像真实照片，但某个地方仍存在微小缺陷；而一张图片也可能没有任何缺陷，却仍然显得不自然。 请分别回答每个问题。 你可以点击选项，或按下数字键 1 到 5。 请以舒适的节奏作答，并相信你的第一印象；虽然没有时间限制，但也不应过度思考。

paragraphs.en: Part 2 of 2: image pairs. Now you will see two images side by side. One is an original photograph and the other has been altered by privacy software, but the order is random, so do not assume the original is on either side. Question 1. What still matches? Tick each characteristic that looks the same in both images. Judge each one separately. It is perfectly normal for some to match and others not. Question 2. Same person? Would you say these two images show the same individual? Choose Unsure if you genuinely cannot tell; that is a useful answer, not a failure. Judge only the characteristics asked about. The two images may differ in many other ways at the same time, and that is expected.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 部分（共 2 部分）：图像对。 现在你会看到两张并排显示的图像。 其中一张是原始照片，另一张则经过隐私软件修改，但顺序是随机的，因此不要假设原始图像一定在某一侧。问题 1：哪些特征仍然一致？ 勾选两张图像中看起来相同的每个特征。 对每一项分别进行判断。 有些特征一致、其他不一致是完全正常的。问题 2：是同一个人吗？ 你会说这两张图像显示的是同一个人吗？ 如果你真的无法分辨，请选择“不确定”；这是一个有效的答案，而不是失败。 只需根据所询问的特征进行判断。 这两张图像可能同时存在许多其他差异，这是可以预见的。

paragraphs.en: Per-condition means with cluster-bootstrap intervals that resample raters ( 10,000 10{,}000 resamples); method-level Spearman correlations of human naturalness against BRISQUE, TOPIQ, NIQE, LPIPS, and the published Q Q (H1), of human attribute preservation against U 1 U_{1} with per-method residuals (H2), and of human same-person rate against P ¯ \bar{P} and fixed-FAR success (H3), each with a permutation p p -value over methods; Krippendorff’s α \alpha for the ordinal items and Fleiss’ κ \kappa for the binary items. Reporting the residuals, not only the correlation, is what makes H2 a test rather than a demonstration.
paragraphs.zh: 按条件而言，使用对评分者进行重采样的聚类自助区间（10,000 次重采样）；在方法层面，将人类感知自然度与 BRISQUE、TOPIQ、NIQE、LPIPS 以及已发表的 Q Q (H1) 的相关性以斯皮尔曼相关系数表示；将人类感知属性保留度与 U 1 U_{1} 的相关性按各方法的残差表示（H2）；以及将人类感知同一人物率与 P ¯ \bar{P} 和固定 FAR 成功率的相关性表示（H3），每一项均在各方法间进行排列检验以获得 p 值；对于序数项，使用克里彭多夫 α \alpha；对于二元项，使用弗莱斯 κ \kappa。 报告残差而不仅仅是相关性，正是这一点使 H2 成为一个检验，而非单纯的演示。

sents.zh: 按条件而言，使用对评分者进行重采样的聚类自助区间（10,000 次重采样）；在方法层面，将人类感知自然度与 BRISQUE、TOPIQ、NIQE、LPIPS 以及已发表的 Q Q (H1) 的相关性以斯皮尔曼相关系数表示；将人类感知属性保留度与 U 1 U_{1} 的相关性按各方法的残差表示（H2）；以及将人类感知同一人物率与 P ¯ \bar{P} 和固定 FAR 成功率的相关性表示（H3），每一项均在各方法间进行排列检验以获得 p 值；对于序数项，使用克里彭多夫 α \alpha；对于二元项，使用弗莱斯 κ \kappa。

sents.en: Reporting the residuals, not only the correlation, is what makes H2 a test rather than a demonstration.

paragraphs.en: Three methods (PGD, Adv-Makeup, MI-FGSM) are statistically indistinguishable from the unmodified original on naturalness (within-rater differences with intervals covering zero) and the other nine are all significantly below it (Tab. 14 ). Naturalness and artifacts correlate at − 0.85 -0.85 across trials, related but not redundant. The originals themselves score only 3.32 / 5 3.32/5 : UtilFace images pass through GFPGAN/CodeFormer restoration, so raters correctly decline to call them unedited photographs. This is a finding about the benchmark, not about the raters, and it means the naturalness ceiling of UtilFace is not 5 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 三种方法（PGD、Adv-Makeup、MI-FGSM）在自然度方面与未经修改的原始图像在统计上无法区分（评分者内部差异的置信区间包含零），而其他九种方法的结果均显著低于原始图像（表 14）。 在所有试验中，自然度与人工痕迹的相关系数为 −0.85 至 −0.85，两者相关但并非冗余。 原始图像本身的得分仅为 3.32/5：UtilFace 图像经过了 GFPGAN/CodeFormer 的修复，因此评分者正确地没有将其称为未经编辑的照片。 这一发现是关于基准测试的，而非关于评分者，它意味着 UtilFace 的自然度上限并非 5。

sents.en: Three methods (PGD, Adv-Makeup, MI-FGSM) are statistically indistinguishable from the unmodified original on naturalness (within-rater differences with intervals covering zero) and the other nine are all significantly below it (Tab. 14 ).
sents.zh: 三种方法（PGD、Adv-Makeup、MI-FGSM）在自然度方面与未经修改的原始图像在统计上无法区分（评分者内部差异的置信区间包含零），而其他九种方法的结果均显著低于原始图像（表 14）。

sents.en: Naturalness and artifacts correlate at − 0.85 -0.85 across trials, related but not redundant.
sents.zh: 在所有试验中，自然度与人工痕迹的相关系数为 −0.85 至 −0.85，两者相关但并非冗余。

sents.en: The originals themselves score only 3.32 / 5 3.32/5 : UtilFace images pass through GFPGAN/CodeFormer restoration, so raters correctly decline to call them unedited photographs.
sents.zh: 原始图像本身的得分仅为 3.32/5：UtilFace 图像经过了 GFPGAN/CodeFormer 的修复，因此评分者正确地没有将其称为未经编辑的照片。

sents.en: This is a finding about the benchmark, not about the raters, and it means the naturalness ceiling of UtilFace is not 5 5 .
sents.zh: 这一发现是关于基准测试的，而非关于评分者，它意味着 UtilFace 的自然度上限并非 5。

paragraphs.en: At the method level, human naturalness correlates with BRISQUE at Spearman 0.517 0.517 (permutation p = 0.09 p=0.09 ), with TOPIQ at 0.336 0.336 ( p = 0.28 p=0.28 ), with NIQE at − 0.133 -0.133 , with the published Q Q at 0.091 0.091 , and with LPIPS at exactly 0.000 0.000 ( p = 1.00 p=1.00 ). The defensible claim is the null: LPIPS similarity to the original has no detectable rank association with human naturalness. The reference-free alternatives do better (the paired gap BRISQUE minus LPIPS is + 0.49 +0.49 [ + 0.32 , + 0.62 ] [+0.32,+0.62] under the rater bootstrap), but with twelve methods even BRISQUE does not reach significance against method sampling, so we do not claim a validated naturalness proxy. HiFD (Balanced) itself correlates at − 0.62 -0.62 with human naturalness; this is the intended trade-off rather than a disagreement, since naturalness runs at − 0.66 -0.66 against P ¯ \bar{P} and + 0.91 +0.91 against U 1 U_{1} , and within the human data the same-person rate correlates at + 0.89 +0.89 with naturalness: the methods humans cannot see through are the ones they rate unnatural. HiFD does not, and should not, track naturalness.
paragraphs.zh: 在方法层面，人类感知到的自然性与 BRISQUE 的相关性为斯皮尔曼等级相关系数 0.517（置换检验 p = 0.09），与 TOPIQ 的相关性为 0.336（p = 0.28），与 NIQE 的相关性为 −0.133，与已发表的 Q 的相关性为 0.091，而与 LPIPS 的相关性则恰好为 0.000（p = 1.00）。 可以合理提出的论断是零假设：与原始图像在 LPIPS 上的相似性与人类感知到的自然性之间不存在可检测的等级关联。 无参考方法的替代指标表现更佳（在评分者自助法下，BRISQUE 减去 LPIPS 的配对差异为 +0.49 [ +0.32, +0.62]），但即使有十二种方法，BRISQUE 在与方法采样的对比中仍未达到显著性，因此我们并未声称其是经过验证的自然性代理指标。 HiFD（平衡版）本身与人类感知到的自然性的相关性为 −0.62；这是一种有意设计的权衡，而非矛盾，因为自然性与 P ¯ \bar{P} 的相关性为 −0.66，与 U 1 U_{1} 的相关性为 +0.91，而在人类数据中，同一评分者的评分与自然性的相关性为 +0.89：人类无法看穿的方法，恰恰是那些被他们评为不自然的方法。 HiFD 并不追踪自然性，也不应该追踪自然性。

paragraphs.en: Pooled over all twelve methods, the human same-person rate correlates with P ¯ \bar{P} at − 0.549 -0.549 ( p = 0.07 p=0.07 ) and with fixed-FAR success at only − 0.247 -0.247 . This pools two threat models. Within the five adversarial methods the Spearman correlation with fixed-FAR success is − 1.000 -1.000 , and within the seven generative methods (GAN-based and diffusion-based) it is − 1.000 -1.000 : humans reproduce the operational de-identification ranking exactly inside each paradigm. The pooled figure is low because adversarial methods are engineered to defeat a recognizer while remaining near-invisible to a person (PGD same-person rate 1.000 1.000 at P ¯ = 0.113 \bar{P}=0.113 ), whereas replacement methods change the face outright (CIAGAN 0.114 0.114 ). The correct statement is that P ¯ \bar{P} is a machine-recognizer privacy score, it ranks operational risk correctly within a paradigm, and humans are not the adversary it models.
paragraphs.zh: 将十二种方法的结果合并后，人类对同一人的识别率与 P ¯ \bar{P} 的相关性为 −0.549（p = 0.07），而与固定 FAR 成功率的关联性仅为 −0.247。 这合并了两种威胁模型。 在五种对抗性方法中，与固定 FAR 成功率的斯皮尔曼相关系数为 −1.000；在七种生成式方法（基于 GAN 和基于扩散的方法）中，该系数同样为 −1.000：人类在每个范式内都完全复现了操作层面的去标识化排名。 合并后的数值较低，是因为对抗性方法的设计目标是击败识别器，同时保持对人类几乎不可见（在 P ¯ = 0.113 时，PGD 对同一人的识别率为 1.000），而替换方法则直接改变了人脸（CIAGAN 为 0.114）。 正确的说法是：P ¯ \bar{P} 是一个机器识别器的隐私评分，它能在特定范式内正确评估操作风险，而人类并非它所建模的对手。

paragraphs.en: No method hides identity from a human (same-person rate < 0.5 <0.5 ) while preserving attributes to a human ( > 0.7 >0.7 ). Only CIAGAN clears the identity bar, and it destroys the attributes doing so; every method that keeps attributes above 0.7 0.7 is still recognized as the same person by at least 61 % 61\% of raters. Sweeping the identity threshold over { 0.3 , 0.4 , 0.5 , 0.6 } \{0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6\} and the attribute threshold over { 0.5 , 0.6 , 0.7 , 0.8 } \{0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8\} leaves the set empty in all sixteen combinations; only at an identity threshold of 0.7 0.7 , meaning 70 % 70\% of raters still say “same person”, does any method qualify, which is not de-identification.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何方法能在保留人类特征（> 0.7 >0.7）的同时，对人类隐藏身份（同一人率 < 0.5 <0.5）。 只有 CIAGAN 通过了身份识别测试，但它在实现这一点时破坏了所有特征；任何将特征保留在 0.7 0.7 以上的方案，仍会被至少 61 % 61\% 的评估者认定为同一人。 当身份阈值遍历 { 0.3 , 0.4 , 0.5 , 0.6 } \{0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6\}，特征阈值遍历 { 0.5 , 0.6 , 0.7 , 0.8 } \{0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8\} 时，所有十六种组合均未产生符合条件的方案；只有在身份阈值为 0.7 0.7（即 70 % 70\% 的评估者仍认为“是同一人”）时，才存在符合标准的方法，但这并不属于去标识化。

paragraphs.en: Krippendorff’s α \alpha is 0.42 0.42 on naturalness and 0.64 0.64 on artifacts; Fleiss’ κ \kappa on the attribute majority is 0.45 0.45 . The naturalness value is below the conventional 0.667 0.667 and must be read as such; two contributors are uneven block assignment (raters were not assigned round-robin, so 78 78 of 312 312 (identity, condition) cells are singly rated and one block drew no rater) and the compressed effective range (originals at 3.32 3.32 rather than at ceiling), which deflates α \alpha mechanically. Method-level correlations rest on twelve points, and the permutation p p -values are the conservative reading. Raters are a convenience sample rather than a demographically balanced panel. Every conclusion above survives all four exclusion rules (pre-specified, n = 22 n=22 ; none, n = 24 n=24 ; dropping the mis-specified check, n = 18 n=18 ; any single failure excludes, n = 9 n=9 ). For these reasons the study supports three specific claims (LPIPS is not what humans respond to; U 1 U_{1} is not too generous to attribute-destroying methods; P ¯ \bar{P} is a recognizer-side score) and one replication of the central finding, not a general validation of HiFD against human perception.
paragraphs.zh: Krippendorff’s α \alpha 在自然性上的值为 0.42 0.42，在人工制品上的值为 0.64 0.64；Fleiss’ κ \kappa 在属性多数性上的值为 0.45 0.45。 自然性值低于常规的 0.667 0.667，必须据此解读；两个因素导致该结果：贡献者分配不均（评分者未采用循环分配方式，因此 312 312 个（身份、条件）单元格中有 78 78 个仅由一人评分，且有一个区块没有评分者）以及压缩的有效范围（原始值位于 3.32 3.32 而非上限），这些因素机械性地降低了 α \alpha。 方法层面的相关性基于十二个数据点，而置换 p p -值则是保守的解读结果。 评分者是一个便利样本，而非人口统计学上均衡的群体。 上述所有结论均能通过全部四种排除规则（预先指定，n = 22 n=22；无排除，n = 24 n=24；移除错误指定的检查项，n = 18 n=18；任何单一失败即排除，n = 9 n=9）。 基于这些原因，该研究支持三项具体主张（LPIPS 并非人类反应的指标；U 1 U_{1} 对破坏属性的方法而言并不过于宽容；P ¯ \bar{P} 是一个识别器端的分数）以及对核心发现的一次重复验证，而非对 HiFD 相对于人类感知的一般性验证。

sents.zh: Krippendorff’s α \alpha 在自然性上的值为 0.42 0.42，在人工制品上的值为 0.64 0.64；Fleiss’ κ \kappa 在属性多数性上的值为 0.45 0.45。

paragraphs.en: All inference and scoring jobs were executed on a supercomputer equipped with AMD MI250X GPUs. We use a Conda environment built on rocm/6.0.3 with PyTorch 2.3.1 2.3.1 . The single global random seed is 42 42 , applied to NumPy, PyTorch (CUDA/HIP RNGs), and Python’s random module at the top of every extraction script. All estimators are run in inference mode with a fixed batch order.
paragraphs.zh: 所有推理和评分任务均在配备 AMD MI250X GPU 的超级计算机上执行。 我们使用基于 rocm/6.0.3 构建的 Conda 环境，其中包含 PyTorch 2.3.1 2.3.1。 唯一的全局随机种子为 42 42，在每次提取脚本的顶部应用于 NumPy、PyTorch（CUDA/HIP RNG）以及 Python 的 random 模块。 所有估计器均以固定批次顺序在推理模式下运行。

sents.en: All inference and scoring jobs were executed on a supercomputer equipped with AMD MI250X GPUs.
sents.zh: 所有推理和评分任务均在配备 AMD MI250X GPU 的超级计算机上执行。

sents.en: We use a Conda environment built on rocm/6.0.3 with PyTorch 2.3.1 2.3.1 .
sents.zh: 我们使用基于 rocm/6.0.3 构建的 Conda 环境，其中包含 PyTorch 2.3.1 2.3.1。

sents.en: All estimators are run in inference mode with a fixed batch order.
sents.zh: 所有估计器均以固定批次顺序在推理模式下运行。
